subject: An ironworker just won. Now what?

body:
The real fight starts now.
| Team, it’s Brian Poindexter, and I’ve got big news.

We won.

I keep saying it out loud because I'm still letting it sink in. A union ironworker just won a Democratic primary for Congress in OH-7, and it happened because working people across this district showed up and said they're ready for something different.

[I’ll cut to the chase, the Voter Protection Project said I could reach out because we need all the help we can get to win in November. Will you split a contribution between the Voter Protection Project and me to power us through November?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109001?t=6&akid=24237%2E878179%2EYdEGhE) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109001?t=7&akid=24237%2E878179%2EYdEGhE) Every dollar chipped in, every door you knocked, every time someone shared this campaign with a friend and told them it was worth paying attention to. That's what won Tuesday night. Not corporate PAC money. Not a political machine. People.

But I'm not going to celebrate for long because the real fight just started. Max Miller is waiting, and he's got every advantage money can buy. His corporate donors are already writing checks, and the national Republican machine is going to do everything it can to hold this seat.

We just proved we can win a primary the hard way. Now we have to prove we can take on the full weight of the GOP in November. That means building a war chest from the ground up the same way we've done everything else, with working people showing up for each other.

name: Claudia Ward
subject: For all the working moms
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131154122/620155598/526203646?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMGUxNmZlYS1kYTRjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SapZ6NuX8TC1mnoVUSrtu4_Gl7FqYdCcA1dXBX5UP6A=)
Hey, it's Claudia, Eric's finance director. You might not know this, Peter, but while I’m running a full-fledged operation for Eric's re-election, I’m also taking care of both my young daughters who are 1 and 3. It's a demanding existence, helping develop young girls into full-fledged, confident, capable members of society while also keeping this competitive operation rolling. And like most working parents, I've seen a lot of pathways to upward mobility that are closing while right-wing extremists hijack our government. I see a lot of pundits and legislators fantasizing about the problematic past, and actors at the state and federal level calling to take us back to the Handmaid's Tale. Our generation already is worried about affording weekly groceries and gas. We're worried about our planet. And now we even have to worry about politicians who are taking away our rights as we lose freedoms our grandparents and parents fought for. **That's why I value being part of a team that supports my ability to do the work on my terms** , and doesn't force a one-size-fits-all view of how a 'working mother' should operate. It means more to work for someone who sees the full extent of my experience, and works to make sure I can thrive in this environment. And I also appreciate working for someone who actually backs up what they believe in, and who goes to bat on so many of the shared issues we face: from affordable, accessible childcare, to making remote work accessible, to balancing work schedules, to ensuring more voices are in leadership positions, to fighting for equal pay, and so much more. [**This is a campaign powered by the caregivers, the people wearing multiple hats, the working mothers. On this election year Mother's Day, can I count on you to chip in to Eric’s campaign today? It's important to support those supporting us, and in a race that’s going to be as competitive as this one, every single dollar matters.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131154123/620155617/526203646?refcode=em-5.10.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMGUxNmZlYS1kYTRjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SapZ6NuX8TC1mnoVUSrtu4_Gl7FqYdCcA1dXBX5UP6A=) | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131154124/620155618/526203646?refcode=em-5.10.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMGUxNmZlYS1kYTRjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SapZ6NuX8TC1mnoVUSrtu4_Gl7FqYdCcA1dXBX5UP6A=)

# West Virginians
# Are Ready for a Change

---
|
---
|
---
| |
Dear Friend,

**You’ve seen the incumbent’s barrage of television ads.**
**You’ve read her mailers.**
My campaign was never powered by political insiders or backroom endorsements handed out before anyone else was even in the race.
**Instead, this campaign has been built the old-fashioned way — by grassroots conservatives and volunteer-driven support from people all across West Virginia.**
And over the past months, I’ve been crisscrossing West Virginia —**shaking hands, visiting communities, listening to voters, and earning support face-to-face** while meeting the hardworking, resilient people who make this state special.
More and more West Virginians are realizing they don’t have to settle for the political establishment.
**People are ready for change.**
Ready for conservative leadership that will actually fight for West Virginia values.
Ready for someone who has lived the same real-world struggles they have — not someone who has spent a quarter century inside the Washington political machine.
**Because this campaign isn’t about political consultants or insider politics.**
**It’s about West Virginians.** It’s about service.It’s about faith, family, freedom, and putting our people first again.
**I’ve spent my life serving this country.**
Now we are just one day away from making history.
**The political establishment believes nothing will ever change.**
**But they’re wrong.**
**I’ve beaten the establishment before — and with your help, we will do it again.**
Because this race belongs to the people of West Virginia, not the political class.
**Tomorrow, we vote.**
And together, we can bring real conservative leadership back to Washington.
**IT’S TIME FOR A CHANGE, WEST VIRGINIA!**
Thank you for standing with me,
**Tom Willis**

## State Demands Muslim School Cease Operations
The Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB) has [ordered](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSszAMBeDTmM4Z2xAwhYu_ocvfbskILBLNGMxYSkJuv8PuEbbX6Hvvfd3GG1Ci7f4fVgxyLHnc8M0JRbCMC01Y8MB1F8rbkssM686Cx-iMa7W5amvHCJQ-Y1PFMJnY2wqD7Trf9F3tffUIfQ2u9fE69V07geu99dHj0k9L3c_GYEXhfGau1lpratNcWtt6ZxvvHLbQ1F41BiNJLhd5oOABvKRPfmG5zHmtUniI7Kzqf8oNyg0RUgLGYy_IfF4oN2B8znBWUG6AacoiOpeIhfWMwKgjMrFouANtLPq5wTyX08SoT3DVz41eWJjko0H0r6HcUJUQ9zelRNx2qjH3FSj9xJK_jfkK7jsAAP__svCMlQ) the recently established Texas American Muslim University at Dallas to cease operations, stating the nonprofit organization has not been authorized by the agency to grant degrees. The Richardson school, which started classes last October and calls itself TexAM University, [claims](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTGO5CoURVeDs1cCTAEOHPzEWf90QusBz2UkMBbQ7erdj1xbmPhK5-jo_vlavzCmeLz-x0xzf29lPehqiXqnum7RUaU35bPHcmylesxn6_ReJZca-BOEWAPG9LuqIcyOh0kMNAtjrJrMaO2wz6REcJOQVm2cOE56mvDJCUcKSlpnhjjfMP4UQgg-cvXQQlsplJWSNKrRMsUpxF7qo-_U6Y1tS7_lh-rDlzykee_9bGz8j8mFyeW6rse1Id4jkwvWHn0iJpe7i8mFwrfHO4fJ5XVTjlIBnSu9wx5fO1WgAK5gDRAo4xEaHKX2HT5qyN8txQytU4bm91ISeMJGUE6qH_BtkdaAtBrd-CSYuHaghPNgzRRAGyM8EoXN-KHO4bxiSrFpwxR_ZYzp09X_7Y2fWf4NAAD__9q7n5c) it's the first university in the nation to offer STEM degrees and require courses in Islamic studies. On Thursday, Gov. Greg Abbott warned that "legal action will follow" if the school doesn't comply with THECB's order. In a statement, TexAM founder Shahid Bajwa said the organization is "_actively engaging with THECB to clarify any misunderstandings and to ensure full compliance with State regulations_." The Texas A&M University System has also accused TexAM of [trademark infringement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHO4yAQBOCnwR3RssY2Llxc4-6_9koLw5KgH0wEe7H_tz8lr3D1SJ9m5s_X9mVjisf9t8208BXKdtDZEjFT3ULcqdJF-cmxHKFUZ_OzMV0bAo4SBqnU5m1MP5vu_LKDn1VHi5omo-epN6Z7LMZp1NMMCmcPE4Te7AEAyYced9LQxeWNwaCUUtCDvo1qNKi0QaTR6t4IDeQjl3rjBzFdtoX0U15Ub67kLi0P5mcT_S-Bq8D1PM_bt6ODX-9Y4GorR5dI4PpeJnBNxdkkcP1Q0mYZW_tLTTqyjaSnFhvLUj1VydV6yrZ-y3iEGo87ZTpY4DoAyBF75w3N0vlhkNq4Wc6OSM6wh925gZzSXV3884wpxTZOQsM925g-vfn_3n4t-C8AAP__azyTVQ). The university demands the destruction of all TexAM marketing materials and the transfer of the texam.education domain name within 10 days.
## Camps Can Open without Fiber Internet
The Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) has [reached an agreement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SpCAURp8GMyxAWuiAYBOz3nRDC-XSUsuPg7db--2ndB5h4q_OrXvOv8f4sCGG_PxrExg8fBkz7FsERKijDxNUOCCtGEr2pc42rRvCMQomespulPPR2RA_o2ycmZi78wYMV0rLu-q0bhbDVe9hdhNINykOswPGfC-1UExa5XUTzHmM3TjnnHVMtj3vteBSCwG9lZ0mkoELWGqLCyAcdvPxU95Q27mkJpoFcd1I94eIgYhh3_f2_2HzORIxnDZEDBdG55Jgo1iozdQ-K0CCjHQPuNDL7JxcLSu9xGlZMcw0ZISaAWmFr1eoP4wvlV4NtldKUIkYmmrcuocYw9YrItkz2RCvD_F3Xd9GfAcAAP__qwCPsg) with summer camps that allows them to obtain a license to operate without fiber-optic internet service, provided they "maintain a redundant, broadband internet service" and meet all other safety requirements. The development follows a statement from Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick and Texas House Speaker Dustin Burrows expressing support for an [exemption](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkc2u4yAMRp-G7KiAkJ8ushjpKrs721kiN5gWFQIDbtPO04_oK9yNZemTfXTsP9_mG3zw-_U3RFzo5ZLZ8agBibAY5y9Y8IUxk0-7S2WDmCvhyyihRi4GLqWx4MPb6M4uF2HPssNFTtOsz1M_z91twXHSoxL9sGmw8oxOWOdUb7V1m0IUnV_aMjFIKaXohT6NcpyV1LNSOILuZ6YFWk-pnOiGhC-oLrzTE8tpS7ELy40oV9b_Ymplaj2O43SvQC1kam02TK2fMabWhmJqFUMrraOU-SfkAY4IdyyV10fOqRAP3pHfr7w-YsTCmzyv4JDevODfhy8YcScewSL3Oz_gjjw5bhFseHMXUrKNyfrVmKf7x_qviNY_IlND_7Wl_YmlQrtsNZSyyXDF2pXF5sOH4Os4MS2uEXz4iNLP3vNc1P8AAAD__xbKp9k) to the new requirement for fiber-optic internet service, established in the wake of last summer's deadly flash floods. Nineteen camps also sued to block the requirement. "_This agreement will ensure that youth camps in Texas operate with the safety provisions envisioned by the Legislature while allowing camps and families to move forward with their summer plans_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGStCAUhE-jGRYPHcCA4E_M5k83tBh5KFUoLrwZndtvjXuETbu7uvrrr_t4tyGGbf5vVzR0-jRueJSIRJhHHx6Y8cR1p5A2n_Jk170QnqPgQjJ-YwCjsyG-x6525sFdDzUaUEp3vWq1rhczgQPx8LKVvYPW9cppa61SXgP3PUx1MJ8yfgMA4C3vGglSC-i0ECht1-qq4-gCpdzQgoSnLT6-0wtzM6W1jmYh2kvV_qvEUInhOI7GlaU0V7KZ06sSw4eJ2YiZSiWGj80y2mnBwuycEVfciF20LO0UJpbx-xnyr_5OT1rYhV5n4_YjxBiKVFXH59WGeM2gv533MuInAAD__xi0htc) DSHS Commissioner Jennifer Shuford. As an alternative to fiber-optic internet service, camps must have two forms of Internet service, including high-speed cable, a cellular, microwave, or satellite connection. Lawmakers have pledged to [address the issue](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMHOpCAQhJ8GbxhoGcUDh714m73u0SC0IwmKgZ7RefuNJv8T_MfuSlXqq3_P8WlDDNvrr13R0DmnccOjRCTCPM5hwownrjuFtM0pO7vuhfAcQUDLxYNLOXob4ndUlTeT8L2s0Miu06rvGq2rxeDUddIJCTPaFl0v-uahvNZ69r4H6apgrjDxkFJK0QhVt7LVIJUGwNaqRjMl0AdKuaYFCU9b5vhNH8y1S2sVzUK0F9b8YTAwGI7jqN1ULopLZzDcFgbD9fo5-Te9aeE3D78xedopOJ7fEbl9ZcQVN-LRHuUdiMFQZeP3I8QYStsxJV6rDfFuQL_b7WPgfwAAAP__FFOEEA) during the next legislative session.
## Texas UFO Sightings
Numerous documented UFO sightings originating from Texas were included in the Pentagon's Friday [release](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykzzGOtCAYgOHTQDeGDxCwoPgbu_m32mxJcPhUEhSDRJzbb3avsAd43-T5erqnjynuy3-_oa33nN2O7UxYKxY3xwkL3rgdNeZ9zuXlt-OseDvOuHqw_gHggo_p7SQNdmJhAIoWtDZy0MIYulo-QB-EF6gGRDDBBDOx3stZ6F6B0DTanxnrAQCYYLJToAwHaThH5aUwRDIMsebS1RUr3v6c0ztfWLpX3miya63HScQ_wkfCx9Za13zplnwRPn6OH4SPtNhwtJhSPJUmki2bj-m3rn8zX5Z_BwAA__9Fw2lj) of 161 files related to Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena, or UAP. On April 14, 1949, 1st Lt. Robert A. Francis [reported](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OhCAUhZ8GOw1cwZ-CYhu72XZLc5XLSIJCgB2dt984r7DdSU7ynZzv5zE_0Hl3PL9xJ10uG-aDzuypFEqzdQslumiPxYXDhrTiHnOhawYOXc1VLcRs0Pn3LCujF25GUZEWfT_IsW-Hodq0WcioAUF2SiouVIuEywoIZEYaUVVO3zCuhBCCt1w2negGEHIAoA5lOzDJybgSUlM2KnRhtv4dXpSaNeyV11spMbP2i8HEYDrPs1m3FI67ZTDddxhMOeJKDCZMxa3-Th9SbRdX_9pQW-cp1wAgRyV4E7dYJW3i6bx3ueuZ5M8dnf9Mlv-Jemn4CwAA__-yJnxz) seeing an object "round and in the shape of a ball, very silver in color" traveling "over 1000 miles per hour" at Carswell Air Force Base. "_It did not appear to burn out, but suddenly disappeared_ ," according to his report. In November 1957, Hockley County Sheriff Weir Clem responded to reports of an "egg-shaped object" that looked like a "blinding-red sunset" near Levelland. Three drivers claimed the object [disabled](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAQRL_GdCCvvTGmcHENXa69EpmwDpYMRngvkL8_kV-4boqZJ837uQ93H1Ncn99-IcdnyMNKR0nETPsQ4kg7nbRsHPMa8v7wy1aYzkFJZWp5qwGGycf0HrCa3CinDipy0LYWu1ZbW80OW98GuI2ovTVd0H4yiJ3Wphs1EUEV3QWTNwAAqSU2BoxVgFYpMh61FShpipz3hmdiOn0J6Z1ftDePvFTJzcxbEfpLqF6o_jiOJuQTrxtXQaj-ikL1n2n9G3K90cr-mdc6xESl2t20HTGlWEwrUD4XH9OHzf8z8nLqLwAA__8ItnW0) their engines. # **Join me tonight at the Chapman Cultural Center**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Db7lmNh8qmZ?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
Join us Monday, May 11 as we hear from statewide candidates Dr. Annie Andrews for US Senate, Billy Webster and Mullins McLeod for Governor, Trav Robertson for State Treasurer, Deshaun Blanding for Commissioner of Agriculture, Mallory Dittmer for Congressional District 5, Courtney McClain for Congressional District 4, as well as local candidates who are on the ballot in the June 9 Democratic Primary.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/hPrde9Z407l?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
This year, we will be joined by special guest Congressman Jonathan L. Jackson, who represents Illinois’ 1st congressional district. Rep. Jackson is the son of the late Rev. Jesse Jackson, a prolific civil rights leader and Upstate native. He will talk about the gutting of the voting rights act and what we can do to fight back.
Tickets include food & beverage. [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dfab**](https://us.list-manage.com/Hz7hdtgH6PW?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
---
| [Learn more and secure tickets](https://us.list-manage.com/cccy_2DOjS6?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
---
|
---
| |
**Call your Rep - tell them NO NEW MAPS!**
---
| |
This coming Tuesday, May 12, the Constitutional Laws Subcommittee will meet again to take up H.5683, which defines the specific map defined in H.5683 ([**https://redistricting.schouse.gov/#plans**](https://us.list-manage.com/MKsqpHhfiYE?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)).
The Senate hasn’t acted yet, but they could move this coming week (the last of the session), to allow consideration of the new map during the “Sine Die" session in a few weeks. (via League of Women Voters SC)
---
|
---
| |
1. ## **Call your Senator AND your House member and tell them that they must vote NO on this midterm redistricting, forced on South Carolina by outside players who have no interest in our people or, apparently in the preservation of representative democracy.**
2. ## **Pack the house! Be there on Tuesday, May 12 at 9:00 AM at the Blatt Building on the State House grounds (arrive early).**
3. ## **Submit testimony on the proposed map at**[ HJudConstitutionalLaws@schouse.gov](mailto:HJudConstitutionalLaws@schouse.gov)**.**

---
| |

## **Talking Points:**
· Implementing a different congressional map would **cost substantial state and county money. $2.5M to host an August primary, $1M to host a run off, $2M for litigation, and $150K per county for August elections.** South Carolina’s current map is gerrymandered but it has been found constitutional by both the U.S. Supreme Court and the S. C. Supreme Court. **There is no legal necessity for reconsideration.** · State legislatures redrawing their maps mid-cycle **reflects political gamesmanship that erodes public trust** , the foundation of representative democracy.· The**redistricting process should include opportunities for public input and comment.** The process contemplated at present provides very little such opportunity.· **A new map would require cancelling or partially rescheduling the June 9 primaries** and beginning again with a new filing process and a new primary schedule, although some military voters have already voted. This would be an administrative burden and a burden for candidates and voters.· People who have donated to their preferred candidate during the months of campaigning that have already occurred **might find that they are no longer in a district associated with that candidate.** · This midterm redistricting has been initiated by a national administration wishing to protect its own interest, **fundamentally at odds with the democratic ideals of our nation.**
---
|
---
| |

[|

South Carolina lawmakers are moving toward eliminating the state income tax, but the shift raises serious questions about who really benefits and who pays more. We examine how replacing income tax revenue with higher sales taxes, property taxes, and fees could affect working families across the Palmetto State. Policy analyst Paige Knight explains what House bill H4216 could change and how tax structure decisions shape public services like schools and infrastructure. If South Carolina’s tax plan moves forward, the impact on taxpayers may be very different depending on where you sit in the income ladder.

_At the end of each week during the 2026 Legislative Session, Nick Sotille will highlight what South Carolina House Democrats did at the State House. Here's what happened during the 17th week..._
**Republicans plan to rig elections by redrawing congressional district lines.** Despite consistently winning 40%-45% of the statewide vote, Democrats currently represent just 14%, or 1 out of 7, of South Carolina's congressional districts. That's not good enough for House Republicans, who - at the direction of President Trump - are taking the unprecedented step of advancing a mid-decade redistricting plan to redraw the lines and make all 7 districts Republican-leaning.
The map proposed by the White House would drastically change the 6th District in an effort to eliminate the state's only Democratic-leaning district and push Congressman James E. Clyburn out of office.

With just one week left in the regular legislative session, House Republicans are seeking to extend session in order to pass the new map. (A _sine die_ resolution controls which specific issues the legislature can address after the last day of session, which is Thursday, May 14 this year).
By a vote of [**87-27**](https://us.list-manage.com/H2kIBdj5Ptw?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a) on Wednesday, the House voted to amend the resolution to add redistricting. Every present Republican voted for it - not a single one of them joined us in opposing this power grab. (Remember that, in case any of them try to act like they are against it later - this vote required a 2/3 threshold to be met, so it was our best and only chance to stop the redistricting effort.) Democrats like [**Rep. Spencer Wetmore (D-Charleston)**](https://us.list-manage.com/v4Ulk1SLXoQ?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a), [**Rep. Roger Kirby (D-Florence)**](https://us.list-manage.com/15IeKY2KjHk?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a) and [**Rep. Kambrell Garvin (D-Richland)**](https://us.list-manage.com/UpSNd0dLNGQ?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a) spoke out strongly against against sine die amendment, but their words were ignored...
The Senate is expected to vote on the amended sine die resolution on Tuesday. We hear that a few Republicans senators oppose redistricting, but it's my personal feeling that they won't be able to withstand the pressure coming from the White House...
Meanwhile, this has caused substantial uncertainty for the current election timeline. On Friday, Republicans rushed to pass out of subcommittee [**H. 5684**](https://us.list-manage.com/IIgOl0dPuxX?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a) \- a bill to push primary elections for Congress from June 9 to August 11. Despite the fact that more than 5,000 ballots have already been mailed (many to military voters overseas), this plan would make voters come out to vote in two separate primaries - and force candidates to run in totally redrawn districts.

This meeting saw testimony from dozens of South Carolinians opposing the redistricting effort - I'll give a special shout out to [**Jaime Harrison**](https://us.list-manage.com/oAazyFjx1fp?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a) for his remarks that covered a number of important issues: the history of Black political representation, the benefits of South Carolina being represented by members of both parties, and a scathing attack on the credibility of the Washington, DC-based Republican operative who drew the proposed map.
"Richland County now looks like a political jigsaw puzzle," he said, later adding, "What God-fearing South Carolinian would put Clemson and the University of South Carolinian in the same district?"
**House passes the Heritage Act 2.0.** With precious few days remaining in the legislative session, Republicans pushed through a bill to add protections to Confederate monuments.
The bill expands the Heritage Act to restrict changes to nearly all monuments, memorials, statues, road names, etc. across the state. It would also restrict updates or additions, including QR codes or other methods of adding historical context to nearby monuments.
While Rep. Spencer Wetmore led the charge with a number of amendments targeting the bill's most restrictive provisions, ultimately [**S. 508**](https://us.list-manage.com/dooyEh52sK3?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a) passed along party lines, by a vote of 74-28.
**The Final Countdown?** Thursday, May 14 marks _sine die_ , the final day of the regular legislative session. The House must adjourn by 5:00pm on Thursday, so any bills (that are not covered by the sine die resolution) must pass or they won't become law this year - they will have to be refiled and restart the legislative process next year. The final week always has a flurry of activity as bills 'ping pong' back and forth between the House and Senate, so stay tuned. But with the redistricting debate looming, this year's sine die might not mean much of a break for the legislature...

I first warned my readers of this threat months ago. Many disregarded it. Let me explain: News just broke that Meta is laying off 10% of its employees (around 8,000 jobs) in a push for "efficiency." On the same day Microsoft announced it will offer voluntary retirement to 7% of their U.S. workers (stated another way, quit now on your terms or we’ll fire you). Which side you’re on could depend on what you do next. Because for those who understand what’s unfolding, this could be one of the greatest wealth-building phenomena of their lives. So, I decided to put my entire career – not to mention every cent I had – on the line to spread the story myself. I left my job as a research analyst... went home to my third-floor apartment in one of Baltimore’s worst neighborhoods... and with a borrowed laptop, I wrote my first financial prophecy. And in an investment paper that’s now been read by more than one hundred thousand people... I explained how the endless miles of new fiber optic cables being laid was creating a new railroad across America. And that this new “railroad” was going to upend the telecommunications industry and pave the way for a new internet economy. I also warned it would decimate some of America's most dominant companies like AT&T.; At the time, this was an outlandish idea, with analysts calling AT&T; “dominant”, “unstoppable”, and “the giant that no other company can topple.” But those who were willing to open their minds to my so-called “radical” ideas were not only able to sell these companies before they collapsed... Since then, I’ve issued a number of other financial prophecies, many of which have come to pass precisely as I predicted. But today, that I believe could surpass anything I’ve ever done... It’s an investigation into what I call The Final Displacement ... and I don’t think we will ever again see a story that rivals the magnitude of this during my lifetime. I’m not talking about AI... quantum computing... augmented reality... the blockchain... or anything else you might be thinking of. No. This is far bigger than them all. In fact... It’s the cornerstone that all our recent technological innovations have been built upon and the future will be built upon too. Outside of the labs in the world’s most prestigious universities and tech companies, almost nobody has. How we work, live, communicate, transact... it will all be completely upended by what’s coming next. Today, I’m going to share it all with you... You see, despite the magnitude of this story, nobody is openly and freely discussing this turning point. And that deeply concerns me, because I believe its emergence will draw an indelible demarcation line in society. On one side, you’ll have those who understand it, invest in it, and who are greatly enriched by it. "The narrative that AI will destroy jobs is very destructive. We should be telling a different, more positive story."
I've seen that sentiment among a dozen major social media accounts in the past week or so. It was like they had a meeting to talk about how to post about it.
Alas, I didn't get the memo, and wasn't invited to the meeting. My calls are with people who are freaked out about what their kids are going to do for work.
Part of it was that many of the bigwigs in tech have figured out that AI is . . . becoming deeply unpopular. It has a 26% approval rating, which is below just about every institution, including ICE. Data centers are being protested around the country. Two people even decided to take a shot at Sam Altman's house (which is terrible, violence is not the answer). The industry has spent $150 million in PAC money to purchase compliance from the two major parties, but that hasn't stopped ordinary people from coming to their own conclusions.
As one person online put it, "Okay, you're saying that this is going to take our job and MIGHT kill us all . . . why am I supposed to be excited about this again?"
As you know, I've been deeply concerned about the impact of AI on employment for years, ever since I published '[The War on Normal People](https://substack.com/redirect/d3422704-6368-4458-b540-d601c957bf1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)' back in 2018. People ask me all of the time, do I feel bullish or bearish on those projections now?
I answer, "It's going to be even worse than I thought, because I imagined you'd have a government or public sector that is trying to mitigate the obvious harms of the displacement of labor." Instead, you have an administration that is out to lunch on the potential impact and a multi-trillion dollar bet on the acceleration of AI that is the biggest outlay of capital in the history of business.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70b03c96-f807-4502-9434-52c694d414aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
More money is now being spent on data centers than on commercial office buildings. If that isn't the clearest metaphor for computers replacing human beings, I don't know what is.
Yet, that is not something that ordinary people and families are going to like. So the new message is, "AI will augment and amplify human productivity, not replace it," or "AI will automate tasks, not jobs."
What's the reality?
Part of the problem of today is that, in today's information ecosystem, reality is a secondary or tertiary concern compared to what the perception is. It's less important what is happening to millions of white-collar workers in real life than what the narrative is out there.
And yet, real life continues. This past week, Cloudflare announced that it was laying off 20% of its staff and attributed it partially to AI. Coinbase made a similar announcement.
I'm a numbers guy, and $700 billion is on track to be spent in 2026 by the hyperscalers on AI infrastructure including data centers. A major sports arena costs a couple billion or so. So imagine 7 new sports stadiums being built in every one of the 50 states this year and you have a sense of the scale of the investment. The only way to make those numbers work would be to replace millions of workers in corporations big and small in addition to efficiency gains or productivity growth. Simultaneously, you have mass layoffs at Oracle, Meta, Block and on and on.
I interview Zach Graumann about this topic and answer listener questions on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/16cedcf8-501b-412e-a250-165b3a261e01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this week. subject: Before politics, before party and before power
body:
I will always put the people of North Carolina first.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1328%2E124072%2EyrjrPk)
| | | | Peter – I’ve been out on the road meeting with North Carolinians directly on the Make Stuff Cost Less tour. They tell me versions of the same thing:
---
⛽ Gas prices are spiking, and it’s costing more to put food on the table.

🩺 They can’t keep up with skyrocketing health insurance costs and get the care they need.

🇺🇲 They’re fed up with the chaos in Washington DC, and they’re worried about the future of our country.
I know we can do better. That’s why I’m in this fight.

**Before politics, before party and before power, I will always put the people of North Carolina first – as I’ve done my entire career in public service. As Governor:**
✅ I expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ I added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ I increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to fight in the Senate for working families – but getting there won’t be easy. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and I need to know that folks like you are in my corner.**

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: They knew freedom was worth fighting for
body:
In the spring of 1775, a handful of farmers and tradesmen stood their ground against the greatest military power on earth.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj9pttthdi2tnm9hem83l914ff9j3vhhpq126ebg_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sli61o74cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In the spring of 1775, a handful of farmers and tradesmen stood their ground against the greatest military power on earth.

They didn't know how the story would end.

But they knew that freedom was worth fighting for.

The "shot heard 'round the world" set in motion a chain of events that led to the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known.

That's why I'm excited to share something special with you.

**The White House recently asked Hillsdale College to assist the Salute to America 250 Task Force in producing a new free video series, [_The Story of America_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znenl1i528mh1t3e9rumn2dj9oraogfmgmpbrb3g_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sli61o74cjh2bs)** --a sweeping, episode-by-episode journey through our nation's founding in honor of its 250th anniversary.

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, this series invites you to learn about the principles, courage, sacrifice, and faith that made America possible--and _why this story still matters today_.

Filmed in the historic Indian Treaty Room in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in Washington, D.C., each episode brings a pivotal chapter of the American story to life.

**Here 's a glimpse of what you can access on your journey at no cost:****
**

* **The Declaration of Independence** -- _Larry P. Arnn, President, Hillsdale College_
How the Declaration of Independence defines who we are--and what it still asks of us

* **The Formation of the Army** -- _Pete Hegseth, Secretary of War_
The moment citizen-patriots took up arms and answered liberty's call against overwhelming odds

* **The King 's Call to Arms** -- _U.S. Senator Mike Lee_
When imperial authority collided with colonial defiance--and compromise was no longer possible

* **The Culper Spy Ring** -- _Brian Kilmeade, Co-Author, George Washington 's Secret Six_
The remarkable story of ordinary Americans who risked everything to outsmart the British and save the Revolution

* **Story of the American Soldier** -- _Michael Knowles, Author and Podcaster_
A tribute to the forgotten men whose sacrifice secured American independence

* **The U.S. Marine Corps Birthday** -- _Vice President J.D. Vance_
The enduring legacy of courage, service, and sacrifice that defines the U.S. Marine Corps

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link: **

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/story-of-america-free-access](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zusjcb6aapfpdg4cdu9tkhv5c2m279bdnfrddah8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sli61o74cjh2bs)**

**As we approach our nation 's 250th anniversary, now is the time to rediscover the spirit of 1776.**

And it's my hope that, by remembering the great deeds of the past, we can inspire Americans today to equally great deeds.

Enjoy your free video series!

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** New episodes will be released throughout the year as we approach America's 250th anniversary--sign up now so you don't miss a single one!

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/story-of-america-free-access**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc41sv607d91ajq77cqb80rbd05ro7mc0kdo5e40_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sli61o74cjh2bs)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. Onward,
Kyle

# **Families of Americans held prisoner in China hope Trump will secure releases during Xi summit next week**
President Donald Trump said he would address the detainment of Pastor Ezra Jin, a Christian pastor and founder of Zion Church arrested in October during China's religious crackdown, during his meeting with President Xi Jinping in Beijing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7f3fceb0-bb68-43a2-9308-f12c7f042b8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **[Grace Drexel, the pastor's daughter told The NY Post,](https://substack.com/redirect/7f3fceb0-bb68-43a2-9308-f12c7f042b8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "If anyone, this president might be able to bring back my father." Jin has reportedly been cut off from his family with no letters or phone calls allowed, while his lawyers have been targeted by the government with one having "his license permanently revoked, and his whole law firm was dismantled." Drexel is expecting her third child in four weeks and hopes Jin will be freed in time to meet his newest grandchild.

* **Dawn Michelle Hunt imprisoned since 2014 after unknowingly carrying drugs in designer bags** : Chicago native Hunt has been in Guangdong Women's Prison for 12 years after winning what she thought was a legitimate travel raffle, only to be arrested at the airport with several kilos of methamphetamines sewn into designer bags she was given as part of her "prize." Originally sentenced to death and later commuted to life, Hunt has developed fibroids and tumors believed to be symptoms of cancer during her imprisonment.
* **Brother promises late father he 'll bring sister home**: Retired police officer Tim Hunt visited his sister two years ago for one hour with a Chinese official taking notes, describing her as looking like "two different people" compared to her arrest photo due to a grapefruit-sized tumor. Hunt's father Gene died January 25 after working tirelessly for Dawn's freedom, with Tim promising him "I wouldn't rest until Dawn was free."

# **Trump blames Obama, Biden for Iran "playing games" with US, warns regime will "be laughing no longer"**
President Donald Trump **[posted on Truth Social](https://substack.com/redirect/f157a772-c51b-4089-a3e7-a41ffa92bbb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Sunday that Iran has been "playing games with the United States" for 47 years through delay tactics before "hit[ting] 'pay dirt' when Barack Hussein Obama became President," accusing Obama of giving Tehran "a major and very powerful new lease on life" through the Iran Nuclear Deal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f157a772-c51b-4089-a3e7-a41ffa92bbb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump: Biden was "even worse" and "greatest SUCKER of them all"**: The president argued Biden proved to be "a disaster as our 'Leader'" who was "weak and stupid," allowing Iran to continue exploiting American presidents. Trump characterized Biden as worse than Obama in dealing with the Islamic Republic, calling him the regime's ultimate benefactor.
* **Administration won 't tolerate stalling tactics or oppression**: Trump declared his government would not accept an Iranian regime that delays negotiations to outlast American administrations while "killing our people with their roadside bombs, destroying protests, and recently wiping out 42,000 innocent, unarmed protestors." He concluded by warning that after decades of Tehran "laughing at our now GREAT AGAIN Country," Iran's amusement would soon end.

# **Trump blasts SCOTUS justices by name who "hurt our Country so badly" with tariff ruling, expects birthright citizenship loss**
President Donald Trump issued **[a 545-word Truth Social post Sunday night](https://substack.com/redirect/e3606cca-41eb-4bb0-ba22-85ab7b949a65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** expressing disappointment in Justices Neil Gorsuch and Amy Coney Barrett after their votes contributed to a 6-3 Supreme Court decision striking down his use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act for tariffs, writing "I don't want loyalty, but I do want and expect it for our Country" and lamenting they "have shown so little respect to our Country, and its people."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3606cca-41eb-4bb0-ba22-85ab7b949a65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump said the ruling "cost the United States 159 Billion Dollars** that we have to pay back to enemies, and people, companies, and Countries, that have been ripping us off for years" and complained the justices could have solved the refund issue with one sentence but didn't.
* **Trump predicts birthright citizenship defeat, criticizes lack of acknowledgment for historic court attendance** : The president wrote that based on his recent experience "being the first President in History to attend a Supreme Court session (Which fact was not even recognized or acknowledged, out of respect for the position of President, by the Court)," the justices "will be ruling against us on Birthright Citizenship, making us the only Country in the World that practices this unsustainable, unsafe, and incredibly costly DISASTER." Trump added "A negative ruling on Birthright Citizenship, on top of the recent Supreme Court Tariff catastrophe, is not Economically sustainable for the United States of America!"

name: Julia Letlow
subject: DC LOBBYIST FLEMING REFUSES TO RELEASE EMPLOYMENT RECORDS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
Fleming confessed he is a paid, active employee of a DC lobbying firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer

| | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/19Xv8XbUtYE?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a)
| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMay 11, 2026
**DC LOBBYIST FLEMING REFUSES TO RELEASE EMPLOYMENT RECORDS** _Fleming confessed he is a paid, active employee of a DC lobbying firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Nearly a week after DC lobbyist John Fleming confessed during the Moon Griffon debate that he remains a paid, active employee of The McKeon Group while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer, Fleming still has not released basic records about his work for the Washington DC lobbying firm.
DC lobbyist John Fleming confirmed that he is currently employed and paid monthly by a DC lobbying firm while also holding a statewide office of public trust. His financial disclosure, filed under penalty of perjury, lists $41,500 in salary from The McKeon Group, Inc. and $120,217 in salary from the State of Louisiana.
DC lobbyist John Fleming’s disclosure states that he served as a Principal at McKeon Group from February 2021 to January 2024, then continued as an Advisor from January 2024 to present.
_“DC lobbyist John Fleming confessed that he is still being paid by a DC lobbying firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer, but he refuses to tell voters exactly what he is being paid to do,”_ **said Letlow Communications Director Katherine Thordahl.** _“If John Fleming believes this arrangement is ‘perfectly ok,’ then he should have no problem releasing the records. The people of Louisiana deserve to know whether their State Treasurer is working for them or working for the DC lobbying firm that is still paying him._ ”
Congresswoman Julia Letlow has called on Fleming to resign from The McKeon Group and release a full accounting of the work he performed for the firm while serving as State Treasurer. Fleming has not released his contract, compensation arrangement, client list, payment records, ethics guidance, recusal records, or communications with federal officials.
**Fleming refuses to answer basic questions:**
* Did Fleming receive a formal advisory opinion from the Louisiana Board of Ethics approving his continued paid employment with The McKeon Group?
* Did Fleming perform McKeon Group work during state business hours or use any taxpayer-funded resources for firm business?
* Has Fleming used his title, relationships, or access as State Treasurer to benefit The McKeon Group, its clients, or prospective clients?
* Has The McKeon Group used Fleming’s title as Louisiana State Treasurer in pitches, client conversations, business development materials, or federal funding discussions?
* Has Fleming taken any official action as State Treasurer involving an entity that was also a McKeon Group client, prospective client, affiliate, contractor, or partner?
* Is any portion of Fleming’s compensation tied to federal funding, client success, lobbying outcomes, business development, or client retention?
* Will Fleming release his full contract with The McKeon Group, all payment records, all client assignments, and all ethics correspondence related to his outside employment?

**Last week, Julia Letlow called on Fleming to release the following records:**
* Any contract, employment agreement, or compensation arrangement between Fleming and The McKeon Group.
* A full list of McKeon Group clients Fleming has worked on or advised since becoming State Treasurer.
* The dates and amounts of all payments Fleming has received from The McKeon Group since January 2024.
* Any ethics guidance or disclosure provided to the Louisiana Board of Ethics.
* Any recusal records involving matters connected to McKeon Group clients.
* Any communications with federal officials, congressional offices, or agency personnel on behalf of McKeon Group or its clients.

**Howell Campaign Focused on Restoring Common- Sense Leadership to Harris County**
---
| | | | | |

As families across Harris County celebrated Mother’s Day, Warren Howell and his wife, Paula reflected on the values that built this community in the first place—faith, hard work, personal responsibility, and strong families. Howell has such gratitude for the mothers who shape families, strengthen communities, and leave a lasting impact on future generations, including those who helped guide and influence his own life.Those same values are driving Howell’s campaign for Harris County Judge as voters continue responding to his clear message: Harris County does not have to keep going backwards.**“Harris County is at a breaking point,” Howell said. “People are tired of paying more and getting less. We need leadership focused on results, accountability, and restoring confidence in county government.”** Howell has outlined a serious plan to address flooding across Harris County, including long-term infrastructure improvements designed to protect neighborhoods, businesses, and families from repeated disasters. He also continues to push for reforms to improve the county jail system by working directly with the courts, law enforcement, and county agencies to stop costly failures and restore operational efficiency.Unlike traditional politicians, Howell has emphasized bringing people together around practical solutions that benefit the entire county, not political agendas.**“This race isn’t about Republicans versus Democrats,” Howell said. “Once the election is over, we all live here together. We need government focused on solving problems that affect every family in Harris County.”** Looking ahead, Howell will continue traveling across Harris County to meet directly with voters, grassroots groups, and neighborhood organizations ahead of early voting and Election Day. The campaign is encouraging residents from every corner of the county to get involved, stay informed, and help shape the future direction of Harris County.**“Our county can be a place where families feel safe, businesses grow, infrastructure works, and taxpayers are respected again,” Howell said. “That future is possible if we’re willing to stop playing politics and start delivering results.”****LOOKING AHEAD: A CLEAR PLAN. A CLEAR CHOICE.** With early voting beginning May 18 and running through May 22, and Election Day on May 26, the campaign is focused on turning momentum into victory. Warren Howell’s plan is straightforward, and built to deliver.

* * *
**Please donate - TODAY! ****I’m Warren Howell and I AM the Disruptor.**

_We CAN lower taxes. We CAN eliminate property taxes for our seniors. _ _And we CAN have a surplus again!_

**SMALLER GOVERNMENT = BETTER GOVERNMENT**. See My full plan to _MAKE HARRIS COUNTY GREAT AGAIN_ on the campaign website. [ _**👉 www.howellforharriscounty.com.**_](https://howellforharriscounty.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8c3a643a45a6e2b06d8f050&id=d8c62dbf43&e=7c92d84deb)
Join our winning team and help lead Harris County to a brighter future with leadership that will **BRING LASTING CHANGE!**

name: Jennifer Grossman (JAG)
subject: Give children a reason to read
body:
You and I will only succeed if we also create our own culture to present to Americans, especially our youth.

|
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgaedcoorjurq4oc1siqkuf9c98kjfvdm4qs6bd8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0slh66p70c1h2bs) Friend,

[In a few moments, I am going to ask you to support The Atlas Society’s new children’s book, _Reason to Build_ , and share why — especially today — it is critical to distribute these books to children around the country.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zep4q9bburiaq3jnm1rpq02hmne5cbnl7857j7v8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0slh66p70c1h2bs)

Critical race theory, COVID shutdowns, trans insanity, the woke mind-virus, and a culture of envy have sparked the most significant education reform movement in generations. _We are liberating families from ideologues and incompetents_.

But here’s something Objectivists, libertarians, conservatives, and any freedom-loving Americans must understand.

**You and I will only succeed if we also create our own culture to present to Americans, especially our youth.**

Here’s the plan:

**This year, The Atlas Society is launching its first-ever children's book series for children ages 3 to 10 featuring kid versions of beloved _Atlas Shrugged_ characters. **

The first book is called _Reason to Build_ , and it features young Dagny, James, and Hank working to build a go-kart — and along the way learning why it matters to think clearly, reject wishful thinking, and create something of lasting value in which they can take real pride.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd1qn9goeokavt8d5obge7o8up1jl5nkmnmv03r0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0slh66p70c1h2bs) Here’s why it’s important today:

Our goal is to raise $32,000 in the next 48 hours to distribute books across the country.

[Friend, can you help us distribute 1 million copies of _Reason to Build_? Please click here to donate $100, $50, $35, or even just $10 today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc1e3egfcivl4qmf4f3p7qa444mecu4g5j62vhb0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0slh66p70c1h2bs)

[Donate $1000](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziipa7ib71knceffj0ghoeic3gmjkgqk01r6k5t0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0slh66p70c1h2bs)

[Donate Any Other Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbq7tnb33r3tj9d6l4k7he9phkep4i9rir2ngu5o_rp22sh2s8i6epr0slh66p70c1h2bs)
When you donate, you are supporting our entire movement to bring REASON back to early education. It’s creating alternatives like _**Reason to Build**_ that will REPLACE awful books like _**Woke Baby**_ and _**Gender Queer**_.

**Our children’s books dramatize Objectivist virtues such as rationality, productivity, honesty, independence, integrity, and justice.**

While other children's books foster a culture of victimhood, envy, resentment, and entitlement.

A child who grows up admiring Dagny's independence and Hank's integrity does not have to later unlearn years of resentment and entitlement. They start from a completely different foundation.

Here’s how you can help:

Today, Republicans hold one of the narrowest U.S. House majorities _in nearly a century._ But Republicans are pulling every lever they have to protect it.

body:
Silicon Valley billionaires want more power. We’re fighting back.
#
Peter,
Silicon Valley billionaires and tech bros are pouring money into our elections for one reason: _they want more power_.
These modern-day robber barons want politicians who will protect their tax breaks, look the other way while they gut communities, and help funnel even more wealth to the people who already have too much of it. And it’s small towns and working families who pay the price.
The local school gets underfunded. The local clinic closes. The grocery store leaves. The job with a decent wage gets harder and harder to find.
Then the same billionaires and politicians responsible for hollowing out our communities turn around and tell working people to blame each other.
**Small Town PAC was launched to fight back.**

If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | ** This campaign is an unmissable opportunity to improve Michigan for my own family and thousands of others. After SEAL training, they sent us to SERE school — that's Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape. Essentially, you learn what it’s like to be a prisoner of war. There were 57 men and 3 women in the class. One of the women immediately stood out — a helicopter pilot who was relentlessly upbeat, totally undaunted by the challenge, and genuinely ecstatic to be there... even while we were being deprived of food and routinely getting roughed up. I knew I needed more of that energy in my life. I asked her out, and two years later, we were married. Fast forward 23 years and Laura and I are raising our two boys with the Michigan values of family, hard work, and integrity. There’s no better teammate to have by my side in this campaign for Congress. ♥️🇺🇲 Thank you, Matt Maasdam 🇺🇸 P.S. This campaign is 100% funded by you, never special interests. Derek, I emailed the other week about how I was going to force a vote on a War Powers Resolution to end Trump’s illegal war in Iran. And I did. The good news is that we doubled the support of Republicans to end the war. The bad news is — we only went from one GOP vote to two. **A strong majority of Senate Republicans voted to block my resolution**. But the longer this war goes on, the more bipartisan support will come our way to put an end to it. Senate Republicans are all too willing to enable a president who is blatantly violating the law and the Constitution, putting our country’s security and our brave servicemembers at risk for _a war with no end in sight_. For over 60 days, prices on everything from gas to groceries have soared. Trump has endangered the lives of our brave servicemembers. And Republicans have continued to greenlight it all. **We need a Senate full of leaders willing to stand up to the president, regardless of political party, for the sake of our country and our Constitution.** And the Democratic Senate candidates who are running in North Carolina, in Ohio, in Maine, in Alaska, in Texas, in Florida, in Mississippi and elsewhere would make a world of difference in the direction of this country. name: Justin J. Pearson
subject: About Tennessee's districts...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, I'm emailing you more
motivated than ever before.

Last week, Republicans passed their racist, outrageous, gerrymandered
districts in Tennessee that eliminate District 9 as the only
majority-Black and majority-Democratic district in our state.

They have cheated their way into a map that favors Republicans, where
politicians are picking their voters instead of voters picking their
leaders.

We need to call this what it is: this new map is a political lynching — an
affront to justice and the fight for equality.

My heart aches for my hometown of Memphis, where I was born and raised and
where generations of my family are buried.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260511-1-jp.2p8fc4&refcode=em20260511-37765&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37765%2E1203867%2EJOX9kG ]Photo of TN State Rep. Justin J. Pearson linking arms with others in
front of the state capitol.

But I refuse to give in to despair. Don't give up hope,
Peter. The fight still carries on, renewed with
urgency as we work to restore the rights that our ancestors marched,
prayed, bled, and died for.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260511-1-jp.2p8fc4&refcode=em20260511-37765&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37765%2E1203867%2EJOX9kG ]This righteous fight for our rights has never been more important, to
push back against Jim Crow 2.0, to end the corruption that runs rampant
and free, to give Black and Brown People a true voice in their democracy.
Our fight continues: Will you please split a donation of $5
right away between me and Justice Democrats to stand against
authoritarianism?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260511-1-jp.2p8fc4&refcode=em20260511-37765&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37765%2E1203867%2EJOX9kG ]Contribute $5

The Supreme Court's ruling in Louisiana v. Callais cleared the path for
this, and I'm sure we're going to see the same playbook in other states
soon, robbing Black and Brown People of their voting rights.

Republicans have taken the only Black-majority district from us. But I
want you to know: No matter what they do, no matter how much they try to
break us and make us bend and quit — we will still be here.

I'm still going to fight to demonstrate strong leadership in TN, and I
hope that you, as a member of this People-powered movement, are still by
my side.

This isn't over, and we will not stop until justice rolls down like waters
and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260511-1-jp.2p8fc4&refcode=em20260511-37765&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1005&akid=37765%2E1203867%2EJOX9kG ]Will you split
$5 or more in the next 30 minutes to fight this
authoritarian power grab?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260511-1-jp.2p8fc4&refcode=em20260511-37765&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1024&akid=37765%2E1203867%2EJOX9kG ]Contribute $5

In Love and Service,

Justin J. Pearson

I became a physician because of my family. I ran for Congress because of my patients.
My mother struggled with mental illness throughout my life. My grandmother helped support our family by bringing us food and getting us clothes from Goodwill. She suffered from diabetes, and she ended up on dialysis and doctors had to amputate both of her legs because of it. She lived with us while recovering. That’s how I learned to dress wounds and to shop for what diabetics could eat.
I became the first person in my family to graduate from college, the first one to become a doctor. I wanted to help people like my mother and my grandmother. I wanted to treat my patients with the respect and dignity they deserved as they navigated what could be the hardest days of their lives.
But after years of watching insurance premiums rise, treating lung conditions from environmental pollution, and seeing families afford less and less of the critical care they needed, I knew I needed to do more.
I wouldn’t accept this as normal. So, I ran for office.
In Congress, I’m fighting to transform our healthcare system into one that leaves no one behind. The bills I’ve co-sponsored include:
* The Keep Kids Covered Act to extend certain eligibility under Medicaid and CHIP
* The Lowering Drug Costs for American Families Act, which would establish limits on prescription costs
* The Seniors Deserve SMARTER Care Act of 2025, which would stop the use of the AI WISeR model under Medicare and stop Trump’s robots from meddling with your healthcare coverage
None of this work is possible without you. Changing our government takes people who refuse to accept the status quo and believe we can do better—especially when it comes to healthcare that’s affordable and humane. If you can, will you chip in $5 today to help me continue fighting for quality and affordable medical care for all Oregonians? I go deep into the third Trump assassination attempt. My family and I were in Mar-a-Lago the day of the attempt, and even waved at the President as he walked outside! Then I unpack the prophetic word about Trump, the power of prayer and angelic protection, the war over the prophetic in America, and Kim Clement's stunning Trump prophecies. We also tackle the growing cultural obsession with aliens, UFOs, and the Nephilim—is it hype, hidden intel, or spiritual deception?
Then I talk about some of the tools we have to fight in our spiritual war, specifically worship. Worship is a weapon. Psalm 149:6 says, "May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands."

This is a call to a new generation of prophetic voices—to bold worship, prophetic intercession, and uncompromising discernment in chaotic times.

Hey folks,
**Jessiah Eberlin** and I went deep on this one. We talked about the war with Iran, Trump's collapsing approval numbers, rising gas prices, and the very real human cost of another reckless Republican foreign policy disaster. This conversation got angry, personal, and honestly pretty emotional at points -- because people are hurting, service members are dead, and MAGA world is still pretending everything is fine.
We also got into the corruption, the propaganda machine, and why Democrats cannot afford to play defense anymore.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] Jessiah breaks down why Trump's Iran strategy is politically collapsing -- and why Iran may only need to survive to claim victory.
* [**00:04:54**] We talk about the midterms, gas prices exploding, and why even aggressive Republican gerrymandering may not save them this November.
* [**00:06:31**] The economic fallout starts getting real: fertilizer shortages, rising grocery costs, and why working families are about to feel even more pain.
* [**00:10:31**] We discuss the deaths of 13 American service members and why Trump must be held accountable for the consequences of this war.
* [**00:17:35**] Jessiah unloads on Trump corruption, billionaire grifting, and the rage people should be channeling into political action instead of despair.

This episode is about more than just foreign policy. It's about accountability, propaganda, corruption, and whether Democrats are finally ready to meet this moment with actual urgency. name: Jane Fonda
subject: The night I met Lily Tomlin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
Nearly 50 years later, this friendship still reminds me why we fight together.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131195012/620255775/1328794144?refcode=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNjMGEwMWY4LTUzNGQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=icY6yYt8cWvDIbe5UiKb5ohwO2cF-zLQc7v3x0LFwPM=&emci=fb5ca9fb-3e4d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4823105)
---
I want to tell you about the night I met Lily Tomlin. It was 1978. I'd just seen her one-woman show, _Appearing Nitely_ , in Los Angeles, and I was completely blown away. She had me laughing and thinking all evening — and I had to go backstage and meet the woman behind it. I thought I was going to be the starstruck one. But when I walked through the door, Lily was just as surprised to see me. Two artists, full of admiration. And just like that, a friendship was born. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131195013/620255776/2105508926?refcode=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNjMGEwMWY4LTUzNGQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=icY6yYt8cWvDIbe5UiKb5ohwO2cF-zLQc7v3x0LFwPM=) It was one of those serendipitous moments you don't realize will change your life. But nearly fifty years later, I can tell you with certainty that meeting Lily changed mine. Since that night, we've shared just about everything — film sets, inside jokes, bad hair days, handcuffs, and more unforgettable moments than I can possibly count. But our friendship has never been just about the laughs. It has always been about showing up when it matters most. Standing side by side at the Women's March in L.A. Protesting the Dakota Access Pipeline. Getting zip-tied together on the steps of the U.S. Capitol. Or just being there when one of us needed a hand to hold. We've always had each other's backs. **And after nearly five decades of friendship, Lily and I have learned the same lesson I’ve learned from this movement:_We are stronger when we show up for each other._** That is what my Climate PAC is all about. People coming together, lifting each other up, meeting our neighbors, and supporting candidates who aren’t even in our states — because we agree that a liveable planet is worth fighting for. JanePAC is bigger than any one of us. It is the more than **50,000 grassroots donors** who keep this work alive. It is the hundreds of climate champions we have helped elect. It is all of us, standing strong together through the power of community. When I look at what we are up against right now — an administration unraveling our democracy, a fossil fuel industry treating our lungs as collateral damage, and a political moment many of us never imagined we would live through — I do not feel hopeless. Because I know who is in this fight with me. So thank you, friend. Thank you for being part of our story. Thank you for showing up. Please take time to connect with the people around you. Get to know your neighbors. Have uncomfortable conversations. Have joyful ones, too. Remind someone they’re not alone with something as simple as a smile. Laughter, friendship, and community are what carry us through moments like this. xx Jane | Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. The Jane Fonda Climate PAC exists to disrupt that status quo by unseating politicians in the pocket of corporate polluters and replacing them with climate champions willing to fight like hell for our planet and the communities we call home. **[If a grassroots donation of $5 is within your means, please use this link to join us in the fight for a better future, with better leaders.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131195014/620255777/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNjMGEwMWY4LTUzNGQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=icY6yYt8cWvDIbe5UiKb5ohwO2cF-zLQc7v3x0LFwPM=)** | [**DONATE**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131195015/620255778/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.3c0a01f8-534d-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNjMGEwMWY4LTUzNGQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=icY6yYt8cWvDIbe5UiKb5ohwO2cF-zLQc7v3x0LFwPM=)

clean_body: Nearly 50 years later, this friendship still reminds me why we fight together. | I want to tell you about the night I met Lily Tomlin. It was 1978. I'd just seen her one-woman show, Appearing Nitely , in Los Angeles, and I was completely blown away. She had me laughing and thinking all evening — and I had to go backstage and meet the woman behind it. I thought I was going to be the starstruck one. But when I walked through the door, Lily was just as surprised to see me. Two artists, full of admiration. And just like that, a friendship was born. = It was one of those serendipitous moments you don't realize will change your life. But nearly fifty years later, I can tell you with certainty that meeting Lily changed mine. Since that night, we've shared just about everything — film sets, inside jokes, bad hair days, handcuffs, and more unforgettable moments than I can possibly count. But our friendship has never been just about the laughs. It has always been about showing up when it matters most. Standing side by side at the Women's March in L.A. Protesting the Dakota Access Pipeline. Getting zip-tied together on the steps of the U.S. Capitol. Or just being there when one of us needed a hand to hold. We've always had each other's backs. And after nearly five decades of friendship, Lily and I have learned the same lesson I’ve learned from this movement:We are stronger when we show up for each other. That is what my Climate PAC is all about. People coming together, lifting each other up, meeting our neighbors, and supporting candidates who aren’t even in our states — because we agree that a liveable planet is worth fighting for. JanePAC is bigger than any one of us. It is the more than 50,000 grassroots donors who keep this work alive. It is the hundreds of climate champions we have helped elect. It is all of us, standing strong together through the power of community. When I look at what we are up against right now — an administration unraveling our democracy, a fossil fuel industry treating our lungs as collateral damage, and a political moment many of us never imagined we would live through — I do not feel hopeless. Because I know who is in this fight with me. So thank you, friend. Thank you for being part of our story. Thank you for showing up. Please take time to connect with the people around you. Get to know your neighbors. Have uncomfortable conversations. Have joyful ones, too. Remind someone they’re not alone with something as simple as a smile. Laughter, friendship, and community are what carry us through moments like this. xx Jane | Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. The Jane Fonda Climate PAC exists to disrupt that status quo by unseating politicians in the pocket of corporate polluters and replacing them with climate champions willing to fight like hell for our planet and the communities we call home. = | = | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Virginia’s effort was a response to that national power grab, not the cause of it. body:
I’m doubling down on my support

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2896%2E4032634%2Ew9f4Px)
---
Earlier this year I announced that I donated over $400,000 from my campaign account to 23 state parties to ensure Democrats win up and down the ballot in November. **I wanted to reach out and share an update: Our team has raised an additional $400,000 to give to state parties in North Carolina, Ohio, Michigan, Maine, Georgia and Alaska.** [**I’ll share more on my decision below, and if you’re able to pitch in $28 or anything you can to support our campaign, you’ll ensure we can continue investing in taking back our majorities this November.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3634?amount=28&t=8&akid=2896%2E4032634%2Ew9f4Px) These six states have some of the most competitive Senate races of the cycle — and I think Democrats can win if we have the resources we need to put up a fight. We need to gain four seats to take back the Senate, which means we need to put up a strong defense in Michigan and Georgia, AND a strong offense in Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, and Alaska. This is how we fight back — hiring organizers, airing ads, and reaching out to more voters. Because Democrats can’t just talk the talk about the midterm elections being critical. We have to put our money where our mouth is. Republicans certainly are. Billionaire donors and giant corporations are giving them buckets of money they can use to cling onto their power in the midterms. That’s why I’m doubling down on my support for these state parties. **This team has now helped contribute over $800,000 to state parties across the country. Because this is what it takes to stop Trump’s corruption and get our government to work for working people.** [**If you can, please pitch in $28 or whatever you can to support projects like this one. And let’s win big.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3634?amount=28&t=9&akid=2896%2E4032634%2Ew9f4Px)

You’ve probably heard a bark or two from my dad, Charlie Bailey, the Chair of the Democratic Party of Georgia. When he’s not taking me for walks or giving me pets at home, dad is making sure as many humans in Georgia are making their voices heard at the polls. He talks a lot about how we need to flip Georgia blue (and I agree, since that’s one of the few colors I can see!). There’s this loud orange guy that my dad rolls his eyes at whenever he’s on TV, and I can tell he is doing everything he can to stop my dad and the Democratic Party of Georgia. body:
