---
| Hi friend, Juan here–

We’ve been on the ground across AZ-06 this past week, and I wanted to give you a quick update on what we’ve been working on.
**📍 ON THE GROUND IN AZ-06** Our field team has been hard at work across the district, meeting voters, knocking on doors, and connecting with families in our communities. Team Ciscomani is showing up ready to listen to and learn directly from you, the voters, what is important to YOU, so we can take that back to D.C. and fight for our district.
---
|
---
|
---
| **🇺🇸 MILITARY APPRECIATION MONTH** May is a busy time of year with the end of the school year, graduation parties, and more. But it’s also Military Appreciation Month, and that deserves proper recognition from our community and our country. While our military and Veterans deserve far more than just a month of appreciation, I want to take a moment to say THANK YOU to those who serve and those who have served. It is because of you that Americans can live freely and pursue the American Dream. As a product of the American Dream myself, I am beyond grateful for those who make it possible. While we could never fully repay the sacrifice of our military members, I will continue doing my part by fighting in Congress to ensure our service members have the resources they need to protect our nation and that our Veterans have access to the care and support they’ve earned long after their service ends. **We appreciate you. We stand with you. Happy Military Appreciation Month! 🇺🇸**
---
|
---
|
---
| **🏡 TAKING ON HOUSING AFFORDABILITY** I had the chance to sit down with HUD Secretary Scott Turner to discuss an issue I hear about constantly throughout Southern Arizona— [_**housing affordability.**_](https://us.list-manage.com/OHjNQpWjc00?e=659fba240e&c2id=0faac43dc15820d3c71d842109aea6ef) Arizonans across the state are feeling the impact of higher rent and home prices and struggling to find a place they can afford. Recent reports have found that Arizona has become one of the least affordable states in the country, with shelter costs driving much of the problem. Here in AZ-06, we have a unique community made up of Veterans, retirees, and families who have spent years building their lives in Southern Arizona. We need to make sure the people who have built this community can afford to stay here, while also creating opportunities for young people and families to put down roots and build their future here too. That’s why I’m focused on practical solutions like the **FAST Act.** We need to cut through the delays and red tape that slow projects down so we can actually build more housing and bring costs back within reach for Arizonans. At the end of the day, this is about keeping Southern Arizona a place where people can afford to live, raise a family, and pursue the American Dream.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/PSHcdFJTc4Q?e=659fba240e&c2id=0faac43dc15820d3c71d842109aea6ef)
---
|
---
| **🚨 STANDING FOR PUBLIC SAFETY** Keeping our communities safe will always be one of my top priorities. That’s why I’m proud to cosponsor the Kayleigh’s Law Act of 2026, legislation that would strengthen protections for victims of violent crimes and sexual abuse by requiring lifetime no-contact protections against convicted offenders in federal cases. The bill is named in honor of Arizona survivor and advocate Kayleigh Kozak, whose courage helped Arizona become the first state in the country to pass a version of Kayleigh’s Law in 2022. Since then, more than 1,000 Arizona victims have secured lifetime injunctions against their abusers. This legislation would bring those same protections to victims nationwide, ensuring survivors don’t have to repeatedly return to court to continue protecting themselves from convicted abusers. Thank you to Kayleigh Kozak for your strength and efforts to protect other victims and to my colleagues in Congress who have supported this legislation. Southern Arizona families deserve safe communities, strong laws, and leaders willing to put victims first. I’ll continue fighting for policies that protect families and keep our communities safe.
---
| **THANK YOU** for your continued support! See you around the district!

– Juan

body:
Republican congressional candidate Justin Story officially qualified for the ballot in Florida’s 9th Congressional District after submitting enough

| | | | | [|

**PRESS RELEASE**
**Justin Story Officially Qualifies for Florida’s 9th Congressional District**
---
|
---
| | May 11, 2026Contact: [Justin@VoteJustinStory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=)
---
| | **ST. CLOUD, FL** — Republican congressional candidate Justin Story officially qualified for the ballot in Florida’s 9th Congressional District after submitting enough verified petitions to meet the state requirement.The State of Florida requires congressional candidates to submit 2,564 valid petitions to qualify for the ballot by petition. As of today, the state has officially processed and verified 2,577 petitions submitted by the Story campaign.
“This campaign has always been powered by the people of Florida’s 9th Congressional District,” said Justin Story. “Every petition signature represents a voter who believes we need stronger leadership, secure borders, lower costs, and someone willing to fight for working families. I’m honored by the support we’ve received across this district and excited to officially qualify for the ballot.”
Story, a Marine Corps veteran and former F-18 fighter pilot, is running to bring conservative leadership and accountability to Washington. Since launching his campaign, Story has traveled throughout the district meeting with voters, community leaders, veterans, and small business owners about the issues impacting Central Florida families.
“With the campaign officially qualified, we are now fully focused on winning this race and delivering results for the people of FL-9,” Story added.
Florida’s 9th Congressional District has become one of the state’s top Republican pickup opportunities following redistricting, with the district now favoring Republicans by nearly 18 points in recent presidential performance.
To learn more about Justin Story, visit [https://votejustinstory.com](https://us.list-manage.com/LqkcsDOjo5E?e=90ad5fc3c5&c2id=d60c3f7cebee07fc4dcb3011da999329 "https://votejustinstory.com")

> Nearly 90 individuals in Minnesota, predominantly Somali's, have been convicted or pled guilty in connection to a brazen scam to defraud the American taxpayer of billions of dollars. Funds that were earmarked for children with autism and to feed struggling families were diverted into the pockets of Somali pirates to bankroll lavish lifestyles and extravagant purchases, such as high-priced vacation homes, sports cars, and countless other luxury items.
>
> While this egregious abuse of public trust implicates multiple players in the Somali community, it also shines a bright light on Minnesota's inept Governor Tim Waltz and his corrupt attorney general Keith Ellison, who was seemingly caught on audio tape engaging in a quid-pro-quo for campaign donations with the same Somali fraudsters.
> [Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=197127960&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3MTI3OTYwLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg1MTkwMDIsImV4cCI6MTc4MTExMTAwMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.DiCq39DcMax6pVeI6f1MazHW-q4TrFR5HMkF-NH9Cuc)
> This isn't simply about a few immigrants coming to America and taking advantage of our generosity, it's about condoned misconduct and larceny at the highest levels of government. It's about systemic corruption and governmental negligence that aided and abetted taxpayer dollars to be hijacked for personal and political gain. Something that seems to be a Democrat calling card across America's blue states these days.
>
> This particular scandal screams government failure at unprecedented levels. Federal investigators have uncovered massive social services schemes that siphoned off billions of dollars intended for programs that didn't actually exist. One Somali defendant has already been sentenced to 28 years in prison, while another has been ordered to pay 48 million dollars in restitution; a sum that makes the magnitude of this eye-watering theft translate from outrageous to apocalyptic.
>
> The mere fact two defendants have already been sentenced, with one of them facing nearly three decades behind bars, should serve as a wake-up call to all parties involved. But more importantly, it raises the uncomfortable questions about the efficacy of oversight in the corrupt blue state of Minnesota, and the mechanisms that failed to detect or prevent this massive exploitation of public funds.
> [Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.uBUb9HOnHjjGDC6kYsAOSbf6ZW1Fttr4iz_eK3KOZO4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=197127960)
> To make matters worse if that were even possible, since 2017, whistleblowers have been coming forward and sounding alarm bells about widespread fraud in Minnesota's Somali community; only to be viewed as racists. In 2018, one whistleblower testified in front of Minnesota's house and senate oversight committee, telling lawmakers he believed as much as "$100 million, possibly more, was being siphoned overseas potentially harming U.S. interests." That was almost 10 years ago. This included "fake daycares," that were being used to defraud Medicaid of millions. These fraudulent centers billed for 12-24 hour days, including holidays and weekends, for hundreds of children daily, despite no actual services being provided.
>
> | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2e7cbaa4-3f64-44a9-b8a3-16b1d8590f01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I'm a pediatrician. I’m pissed. I’m scared. And I need your help to defeat Lindsey Graham in the U.S. Senate.
I’m not the “monsters-under-the-bed” kind of scared. I’m the “I’ve watched children suffer from preventable illness and injury while politicians do absolutely nothing” kind of scared.
I’ve treated kids who’ve been shot. Kids whose families struggle to afford their medications.
Kids who live with mold that causes asthma attacks, miss school for climate disasters, and watch politicians use them as political pawns.
And now? Trump is causing chaos and Lindsey Graham is right by his side.
And Medicaid — the program that keeps half our pediatric patients insured, healthy, and...alive — is on the chopping block to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
So yeah, I never planned to run for Senate.
But I’m scared. I’m pissed. I’m motivated. And I’m 100% in.
I’m running for Senate in South Carolina to defeat Lindsey Graham and to fight for the kids no one in D.C. seems to be thinking about. So I need you with me.
We need to hit 10,000 donations before midnight to prove that this campaign can go the distance. Can I count on you to split a donation with my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
I’m running because the Republican Party, led by people like Lindsey Graham, is dismantling the very systems that keep our kids safe here in South Carolina.
I’m running because the issues I care about — children’s healthcare, vaccines, gun violence, public education, Social Security, Medicaid and Medicare — are under direct attack right now.
And I’m running because I consider it my professional duty as a pediatrician — to give children a strong voice at the national level. Too many are comfortable on the sidelines. That won’t work for me.
We need bold leaders who aren’t afraid to fight. I am ready.
Even though the path will be hard, I know Lindsey Graham must be held accountable. He certainly doesn’t deserve a free pass back to D.C. for six more years.
That’s why I’m running for US Senate. To defeat Trump’s lapdog and fight for everyday Americans. But, I need your support today. name: Mallory McMorrow
subject: Thank you for the Mother’s Day surprise
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McMorrow for Michigan
body:
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4682%2E898137%2Edtik6a)
Hey ,
Yesterday, I walked into the kitchen and saw what Ray and Noa had been working on all weekend.
I knew Noa was busy drawing, but I had no idea that so many of you were in on the surprise, too. Reading through the names and the notes you all sent... I’m a little bit speechless.
[](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-may2026._5OkES&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260511_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4682%2E898137%2Edtik6a)
Between Noa’s drawings and the sheer volume of support from this community, I feel incredibly lucky. Being "Mama" is my favorite job, and every day I remind myself: I’m running for Senate so our kids have a better tomorrow.
Yesterday was a beautiful reminder of why I do this. When the days get long and the campaign schedule gets grueling, I think about the world we are building for Noa — and for all of our families. Knowing I have my people standing right there with us makes the hard work easy.
We are running a different kind of campaign — one built on showing up, telling the truth, and looking out for one another. That doesn't happen without the resources to reach every voter in every corner of this district.
[**If you’re able, will you make a donation today to help us keep this momentum going?**_](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-may2026._5OkES&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260511_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=4682%2E898137%2Edtik6a)

– Mallory

## The Capitalist exists because of you, and we want to hear from you!
**[Become a paid subscriber today and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/ab0ba4f9-350c-49b7-9e6b-95fdacf36f89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Subscribe here now](https://substack.com/redirect/ab0ba4f9-350c-49b7-9e6b-95fdacf36f89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
**America didn 't lose its manufacturing edge overnight.** Decades of globalization shipped it away, one factory at a time, in the name of lower prices and fatter corporate margins. The result was simple and brutal: we stopped making things that matter. Semiconductors, rare earth minerals, steel, even basic components for cars and defense systems--all outsourced, mostly to China. Supply chains stretched thin across the Pacific. American workers watched plants close and towns empty out. When supply chain shocks hit, like the pandemic or geopolitical flare-ups, the bill came due in higher costs, shortages, and vulnerability that hit regular families hardest.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d428b447-3723-45ab-91a6-359dbfade2a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump's corrective actions are exactly what's required to reverse that slide. No grand theories, just direct orders. The latest, **[he told every federal agency](https://substack.com/redirect/3ea17403-5045-45a8-914c-e5461215c262?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : buy American, no excuses. Waivers that let foreign goods slip through are getting the ax. He's enforcing the Made in America rules he signed into law earlier this year, cracking down on fake labels and rubber-stamped exceptions. This isn't symbolism. It is policy that puts taxpayer dollars behind U.S. factories and supply chains instead of sending them overseas. This is building block 101 for a country.
Critics are already rolling their eyes. The market, not government, should decide, they say. Government intervention picks winners and losers. In a perfect world with a level playing field, that argument might hold water. It doesn't anymore. American companies spent years trying to compete on price against rivals whose governments didn't even pretend to play fair. China manipulated its currency, tolerated near-slave labor conditions, and ignored environmental rules that would shut down any U.S. operation overnight. Toxic waste, child labor in mines, zero regard for worker safety--none of that showed up on the price tag. The only thing that mattered was undercutting everyone else until American plants couldn't stay open. That isn't competition. It's economic warfare dressed up as "free trade" and there were plenty of people on both the left and the right who applauded it.

# [The Next Breakout Might Be in Your Pocket](https://substack.com/redirect/982e9ea5-aea1-456f-bdd6-c250c82a09b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/982e9ea5-aea1-456f-bdd6-c250c82a09b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Everyone's hunting for the next Unicorn.
The type of "category disruptor" that grows fast and turns early believers into big winners.
59,000+ investors think that**[Mode Mobile](https://substack.com/redirect/982e9ea5-aea1-456f-bdd6-c250c82a09b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **could be one of those rare finds.
Americans spend 4 1⁄2 hours on their phones daily, and Mode Mobile is monetizing that screentime. With **[$1B+ earned by over 490M customers](https://substack.com/redirect/982e9ea5-aea1-456f-bdd6-c250c82a09b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and 32,481% revenue growth, Mode's EarnPhone is turning smartphones into income generating assets.
Their previous raises sold out, and the company is now offering pre-IPO shares at $0.50/share with up to 20% bonus, exclusive to early investors.
Being early is everything, and this window is still open.
**[Review the offer before it closes](https://substack.com/redirect/982e9ea5-aea1-456f-bdd6-c250c82a09b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
* * *
Trump's Buy American strategy cuts through the nonsense. It builds a foundation for both economic security and national security. We saw the first moves with rare earth minerals. For 25 years the green movement, chasing Al Gore's vision of environmental virtue, blocked domestic production at every turn. The most visible example was Mountain Pass, once America's biggest rare earth mine in California's Mojave Desert, closed in 2002 after a spill and the following regulatory hammer. It reopened briefly, only to go bankrupt in 2015 because Chinese state-subsidized dumping flooded the market.
## [The Green Left Crippled America While Empowering China For 25 Years](https://substack.com/redirect/bfe697e2-1136-41d8-a11a-509845027220?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[](https://substack.com/redirect/bfe697e2-1136-41d8-a11a-509845027220?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Without domestic producers, the whole "green revolution" collapses--and so does U.S. defense capability. Trump's team didn't wring hands over ideology. They guaranteed government buys for domestic output. No more letting price alone decide. That's practical discipline meeting national interest.
The same pattern repeated with oil. "Drill baby drill" wasn't a slogan; it was policy that ramped up domestic production and shielded the country from Middle East supply shocks. American energy independence isn't some abstract win. It keeps gas prices from spiking every time a tanker gets threatened and keeps factories running without having to make geopolitical friends with foreign regimes we want to distance ourselves from.

* * *
* * *
Most recently, the Intel turnaround shows the model working in real time. Last August the government took a minority stake in the struggling chipmaker. Intel wasn't some charity case--it had real problems with delays and market share loss. But the stake provided stability. Apple is reportedly in serious talks to use Intel chips for U.S. devices. That's not just good for shareholders. It's strategic. We no longer have to rely solely on Taiwan or other vulnerable spots for advanced processors. That's what disciplined industrial policy looks like.
## [Trump's bet on American manufacturing is paying off big time](https://substack.com/redirect/f8230965-2aab-4900-9eaa-a93d6c331d66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---|---|---
| May 6
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f8230965-2aab-4900-9eaa-a93d6c331d66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f8230965-2aab-4900-9eaa-a93d6c331d66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/f8230965-2aab-4900-9eaa-a93d6c331d66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
None of this ignores capitalist principles. Trump isn't nationalizing factories or dictating product lines. He's correcting a tilted playing field so markets can actually function for American companies. Pure laissez-faire worked when competitors operated under similar rules. It stopped working when one side treated trade as a tool for dominance and American industry had first one and then both hands tied behind its back. Ignoring that reality isn't principled--it's naive. At the other extreme, pure government control without market signals leads to waste and stagnation. We watched that play out with years of green energy subsidies that propped up projects while real manufacturing atrophied. The green left's focus on emissions and ideology outsourced the very materials needed for their own agenda. The result was dependence on China for the guts of wind turbines, solar panels, and EVs.
Balancing the two--market discipline plus clear national interest--is the only path that avoids ruin. One without the other fails. Let markets run unchecked in a rigged game and you end up with empty factories and strategic national weakness. Let government run unchecked without market feedback and you get inefficiency and cronyism. Trump's approach threads the needle: targeted support for foundational industries, strict Buy American rules for **federal spending** , and enough room for companies to compete and innovate. The Intel example proves it. So does the rare earth strategy. So does the energy push. Each step rebuilds the industrial base that underpins both economic strength and national security.
The practical impact lands on regular people:
* Factories reopening mean jobs in places that lost them years ago.
* Stronger supply chains mean fewer shortages when the world gets messy, because the idea that it won't is is a fallacy, just look at Iran, Ukraine, Covid. None of those things were meaningfully on anybody's radar 15 years ago.
* Lower dependence on adversarial nations means fewer price spikes passed on to consumers.

It's not glamorous policy. It's the gritty work of reversing decades of self-inflicted damage. Critics can keep quoting textbook economics about government staying out of business. Those textbooks never accounted for a rival that treats "free trade" as zero-sum warfare.
This climb back isn't guaranteed. Intel still faces challenges. Rare earth projects take years to scale. But the trajectory has shifted. For the first time in a generation, policy is treating American manufacturing as a strategic asset instead of a relic. No exaggeration, no corporate spin--just facts on the ground. Factories hiring. Stocks climbing. Supply chains shortening. That's what balancing economic discipline with national interest actually delivers. Anything less leaves the country weaker, poorer, and more vulnerable the next time someone decides to squeeze the flow of critical goods.
America didn't get hollowed out by accident. Reversing it takes time and deliberate, strategic, unsentimental action.
Trump is delivering exactly that.

| Peter,
As you likely know, the Louisiana GOP has cancelled our upcoming May 16th Congressional elections. However, many critical elections are still happening.
They thought they could create enough confusion to trick people into thinking every election was canceled.

Maybe by $20 a month. Maybe by $50. Maybe more. And yet nothing really changed. No accidents. No tickets. Same car. Same driving habits. It's happening all over the country right now. [Insurance companies have been raising rates aggressively](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL1uxCAQhJ8Gd3eCNbZxQRHpdN2lTWlhdjkjYWPB5n7ePnKqPEC6T5qZr5iv23RzMcXt_ulWsvwKeULC6B0TThs9ayJmKtNzebtCNa9ue2OJDyq1fiPSNoGE_iS7k1J_lqpBO0scVUNWDYPpALQemsUqN0MfDAStVRgBvJSBAmqUs5mVHJtoD6HslFJGSt2dzdjOXvpugBa6sUehJWHkXM68ENPL1ZDe-UHl7PPaJLsw71W0HwKuAq57yUyeCfPOMW_1KB1Je3WivShtOgG9P9AYOLgq0V6aYnF_xpRi7Qeh5X11Mf36-T8_elj4CQAA__93qn6R) over the last few years, and many drivers are simply absorbing the increases because shopping for insurance feels like a hassle. Most people assume comparing rates means filling out endless forms, sitting through sales calls, or spending an entire afternoon jumping between websites. That's exactly why companies like [Insurify](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL1uxCAQhJ8Gd3eCNbZxQRHpdN2lTWlhdjkjYWPB5n7ePnKqPEC6T5qZr5iv23RzMcXt_ulWsvwKeULC6B0TThs9ayJmKtNzebtCNa9ue2OJDyq1fiPSNoGE_iS7k1J_lqpBO0scVUNWDYPpALQemsUqN0MfDAStVRgBvJSBAmqUs5mVHJtoD6HslFJGSt2dzdjOXvpugBa6sUehJWHkXM68ENPL1ZDe-UHl7PPaJLsw71W0HwKuAq57yUyeCfPOMW_1KB1Je3WivShtOgG9P9AYOLgq0V6aYnF_xpRi7Qeh5X11Mf36-T8_elj4CQAA__93qn6R) have taken off. Insurify is a comparison platform that lets you check auto insurance quotes from multiple insurers in one place, side-by-side, in just a few minutes. Instead of manually visiting a dozen insurance websites, you answer a few questions once and quickly see what different companies may charge for similar coverage. [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL1uxCAQhJ8Gd3eCNbZxQRHpdN2lTWlhdjkjYWPB5n7ePnKqPEC6T5qZr5iv23RzMcXt_ulWsvwKeULC6B0TThs9ayJmKtNzebtCNa9ue2OJDyq1fiPSNoGE_iS7k1J_lqpBO0scVUNWDYPpALQemsUqN0MfDAStVRgBvJSBAmqUs5mVHJtoD6HslFJGSt2dzdjOXvpugBa6sUehJWHkXM68ENPL1ZDe-UHl7PPaJLsw71W0HwKuAq57yUyeCfPOMW_1KB1Je3WivShtOgG9P9AYOLgq0V6aYnF_xpRi7Qeh5X11Mf36-T8_elj4CQAA__93qn6R) And the differences can be surprisingly large. For families with multiple vehicles, teen drivers, long commutes, or recent renewals, [even modest monthly savings can add up fast over the course of a year](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL1uxCAQhJ8Gd3eCNbZxQRHpdN2lTWlhdjkjYWPB5n7ePnKqPEC6T5qZr5iv23RzMcXt_ulWsvwKeULC6B0TThs9ayJmKtNzebtCNa9ue2OJDyq1fiPSNoGE_iS7k1J_lqpBO0scVUNWDYPpALQemsUqN0MfDAStVRgBvJSBAmqUs5mVHJtoD6HslFJGSt2dzdjOXvpugBa6sUehJWHkXM68ENPL1ZDe-UHl7PPaJLsw71W0HwKuAq57yUyeCfPOMW_1KB1Je3WivShtOgG9P9AYOLgq0V6aYnF_xpRi7Qeh5X11Mf36-T8_elj4CQAA__93qn6R). In a time when nearly every household bill seems to be creeping higher, many people are realizing this is one of the easier places to potentially cut costs without changing their lifestyle. The reality is most insurance companies count on inertia. They know many customers will simply renew year after year without checking competitors. But rates can vary dramatically from company to company, even for drivers with nearly identical profiles. That's why comparison shopping matters more today than it did a few years ago. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Blame John Roberts for Destroying the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=051126_1&amount=25]
Team: Louisiana v. Callais is based on a lie . It also represents the culmination of John Roberts' decades-long mission to end the Voting Rights Act.
First, the lie: Writing for the majority in the Supreme Court's decision gutting the Voting Rights Act, Justice Alito declared that " the racial gap in voter registration and turnout has largely disappeared ." That's simply not true, and Trump's Department of Justice has admitted to the press, after the fact, that it used alternative measures to write the report that Alito cited.
In truth, amongst underrepresented communities in comparison to their peers:
➜ 2020 voter turnout was 14% lower.
➜ 2022 voter turnout was 23% lower.
➜ 2024 voter turnout was 17% lower.
These numbers represent actual people – predominantly voters of color, young people, and women – whose voices are being systematically pushed out of our elections. The gap Justice Alito says has "largely disappeared" is real, ongoing, and growing.

As for John Roberts? He's written or joined the majority on every major case the VRA has faced -- 2013's Shelby County v. Holder , 2021's Brnovich v. DNC , and now 2026's Louisiana v. Callais .
His self-appointed mission to end the Voting Rights Act started in the 1980s , when he was just a young lawyer working in Ronald Reagan's Justice Department. He fought Congress on behalf of Reagan's administration, essentially claiming the VRA was affirmative action for voting rights. A bipartisan Congress in the 1980's disagreed, overwhelmingly reauthorizing the VRA and strengthening it over Roberts' objections.
Fast forward to his confirmation hearings for Chief Justice, when we called the VRA a "settled question," then, upon being confirmed, immediately got to work ending it . He wrote the majority opinion for Shelby County v. Holder , knocking the first leg out from under the VRA and setting the stage for a decade-plus of further challenges.
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Roberts Court held this case over from last year. He's accomplished his mission to take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. The VRA no longer stands in the way of white majorities locking racial minorities out of elected office through race-based gerrymandering.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/115406/images/pout-header-3.png]

Friend,

The only thing MAGA Republicans do is break promises and come up short.

❌ Donald Trump campaigned on a promise to start "no new wars." Then he went on to start a war without approval from Congress — costing US taxpayers over $25 billion as of this week since the war began.

❌ MAGA said your tax refund would be $1,000 higher this year. But the average refund isn't even close.

❌ They also said they'd lower costs for families. Instead, costs are rising across the board — from groceries and gas to utilities and healthcare.

We need leaders in Washington who will hold MAGA Republicans accountable for their broken promises and inaction. That's what I've been doing in Congress, and it's why I'm running for re-election to keep fighting and help Democrats win back the House.

body:
The plan was bold. The results are real. | | | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8b65634747e849d29e4aaeedb8026c4d&_e=grQc7K7htIG5qDbMoPb8-oT5Ss1VvS6HGVSKPGs8SSCdwERo3bhUw4FTKUATpBBDZpA4kfRIxPyE5VESO7ft2B__O9vzQYkNQ0gi2TyESkn5OTzM-AIKivGccO5pKsIEmx5dHncb5AeOM4rKmRogBTJOqHVUJKl0zrZXaa2nfQSx99DZKDLQDV8e_zMhhz8GPFHd83Dy_v-b0XzvxlgpszvzGSzGmwD-81C7eiValGWuy650MsCVB2Y7Zrh2J641yUsYvsCkq4HADBDY-9TdQxJy4NYfC1L3RIwPSQbHAy5RThmHWufKODr_7d2NWugZa4IVjK8-yVBXKgw-sM1IKtgkx1r1qbc8oVCgsDd3a87GqTxJ1K91itcnA9hm7GNO2Gcw8SKDmvPR4rjNk-TqK_1xK2gYABRZSdZzGdc9GguPvsWk1zpFpdQhBuQ92xV-4LJ54ieiScg-JOAOaNon7OkfzBtBvqZcm6dSm7IAf5pLOhHHdZF75ubWMVpO4lGaWlz94BoGsV8k08SD2-EewmgUrpyfrYdFSjmrS4MzZ0SgUW3J6JWGZfeQki_YGuJd5mXMb15hCaSGyaWRlI-LHcQTyJLSaiSRtoAuP7jyBdkQfCgZcf4AndVgyDeh8wBdrUjlYBrD2OKPv4EUWAhUd7Jx_ZYMbTgeZhTwtyesor-6JEW2bqGFE8kE2Hu-KWG33OK4hEt3XsyYsOogSkEIVg%3D%3D)
---
| | Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8b65634747e849d29e4aaeedb8026c4d&_e=grQc7K7htIG5qDbMoPb8-oT5Ss1VvS6HGVSKPGs8SSCdwERo3bhUw4FTKUATpBBDZpA4kfRIxPyE5VESO7ft2B__O9vzQYkNQ0gi2TyESkn5OTzM-AIKivGccO5pKsIEmx5dHncb5AeOM4rKmRogBTJOqHVUJKl0zrZXaa2nfQSx99DZKDLQDV8e_zMhhz8GPFHd83Dy_v-b0XzvxlgpszvzGSzGmwD-81C7eiValGWuy650MsCVB2Y7Zrh2J641qXSHDejkcjTiEo8fHF2lwdybLO25Wr5BCw3Kc4TL0qAPeTF2wB-p8wun-s_0XogfoA2QXqdYu7oaYAAMxVngiSBDaH0pTa9AQ2W0FwNKT6VtjhhVcQP5ocQh3OTbRA_KF0DdK4ouJiIHoUi3UXYdVA7EX1ij9Lpesvy2gJbQQMLB_fpMKiXrrHhgGs8tBiF6dUCNb-ckR-V6_NfIAivkIJz-fn34kc85q0OBP_oOxPV2jDvM0InstwzPYj52ZHxquf0rUiOq_RnWix30UQMdwT0wJkfBm9-t7v_wL2PAfr1CACbZcwnOy5iRxAjU6MDHs0fy3fnWIPezc0jovEp_zVw9F3CuD7nMX3_LuRW7TOaNhlXAObp15uudif-unluGwwo3vNaqhR19bPZAK2vK1fly0L_cVx-1Iwk9MFfs9qDJPjg5YBBt4AjsIYkJb7BURqbQRlzeGr7nQAq6H-mpXQ%3D%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8b65634747e849d29e4aaeedb8026c4d&_e=grQc7K7htIG5qDbMoPb8-oT5Ss1VvS6HGVSKPGs8SSCdwERo3bhUw4FTKUATpBBDZpA4kfRIxPyE5VESO7ft2B__O9vzQYkNQ0gi2TyESkn5OTzM-AIKivGccO5pKsIEmx5dHncb5AeOM4rKmRogBTJOqHVUJKl0zrZXaa2nfQSx99DZKDLQDV8e_zMhhz8GPFHd83Dy_v-b0XzvxlgpszvzGSzGmwD-81C7eiValGWuy650MsCVB2Y7Zrh2J641yqS97RDFVhJAyCZHI2Vi7FVPgVVuTQYQbMB0A9o-CdutJnrlZQ8QWecmXi1eGBkLtUmKLjMFO5x1mMS2pBvg5z-gO7cbpWMcFcQaDupaGJGnznzNPeWnIXgFILEOokjJy_rGWyoUZrc6vcTuq29qh39HXtkT_S4Y_V1HkVoclqNhaw6f1kDAlcU9p3H02SZuHPc3KOjgBnX6FqfHaJ5L_o6eILRZ5vHTtWAt2lkgpa-q6bAWrsCNhr6KQxgga0mnA2A99_YcIDbjol2JUJn3xlsEsH4usfjnUqXscIdKDXCJwlwobAUXAHLQ-jf4IXECWn5Mbhu3wc_o8DZSxezbZQY-NDQik9sycbxCP4x4Hc40hVQEHCWr5fH8wEFOai7tHaLucME7VNvkE8pEW8Bgm_7ZiYOn2M4VOKQpkOirRForGrPzvVsyCKb1r2mG8nOWmzDuqNI3fE_F6gEzqJFNqQ%3D%3D)
---
_But now, Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

Peter,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America’s 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=aeda3878853241ac8447d2c089586415&_e=hCO_KNAGv7jmMXANO3BdIdWiGRRzlZw5KGQraBntOByr64qLx8faX25l8ueXuZqTWvPFET-MyjgVRMHjvBgNt-r0z5LNm7ihGDQKXAc4-mP19bK5oWax878qjAIpUeH6hC65aQ0-FNOAGC6wk0bJNZ-x_qohIJ3l7c0qeLO1LrO48yeMmBZof89olz-Hp23n7tQLmaKb-yrdMqnDaOFaCRzZK-kCi2x-13w_jtRMsJLlDSJV4JJFMy8GnIShSNiu_bwj0dk8K-pB1tvj7O7LYr50stIcvoWv6rZWZEuToSxvQpRmj3tZ9uCUqSaINTrIiasjSE5e8YBc7yWmzPjV4A-qZdbPLjm01eWZuzNHSJ3xvYUM03m07IC5oQgvSfELZk1eGqnlRBjlk1FtaEQuTMfH0J6v_0hBY7OKzsQ5j_RKUbS7y3lp8JHhsdWe7rIGAbM9BUJk-Qgh14YsDX-vo65kDtp2KB1jicUpKlKI1T9-rQRn_pBWeo2KbWTxonJWdp4dy2ToVnzQe3A0RoWFMjDFCwOrzXbq7CE6D8krhPDmRDB2lE_rGczTXocgdjAFgYhw7WLeWCmf0w-78peL6Pb17NHbHiTPmQ4QpaGU2jirLY7W8YGBGJ8NHIf9EtwMqMtryIuz3OYuqH_UdjeuOAQHBgCTlUWSXlc7Wa_L6mnjklswLDGKSlUFAJ0lrncTLGXXY9uICooRtQ6Z54L_gQ%3D%3D)**

clean_body: As America turns 250, we must honor them while we can | | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. Peter,

**I don 't need some activist judge or out-of-state group telling me what Alabama is supposed to look like.**

Neither do you.

For years, people who've never spent five minutes in our communities have tried to shape this state from the outside--drawing maps, setting rules, and acting like Alabama voters shouldn't have the final say.

That's wrong.

And honestly, people here are tired of it.

We know who we are.

We're conservative. We believe in faith, hard work, and common sense.

And we ought to be represented that way.

That's why this moment matters so much.

The rules changed. We've got an opportunity to finally put Alabama back in Alabama's hands--and we can't waste it.

**The Left fights for every inch of power they can get. They never apologize for it. They never slow down.**

_Meanwhile, Republicans are expected to play nice and wait our turn._

I'm done with that.

**I want Alabama to fight for Alabama.**

And if you do too, I need your support right now.

**[Chip in whatever you can and help me keep fighting for Alabama.](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=de647d4d42114a4aacb814ecd77b5c70&_e=JOgvPjCqGp0SdQOf820syCKo9u2oLXRpLB7w8OT-l4EiVTsOxbUyFXMGMigy2jHlJ_xNel0vUr-Yj5GTp2W_mS05P4jzEmgHaV0S4DqgjzXqZMhWz2k91JgaHwi1BpznDgKoSR251P5F25AC80d01kMzxD4Hvna50P0QQ9BzT5I9Ua4EztSjpnR7qddY63kqcGsUb9b_seCHIkTg5wjBYLYNlqfCjud_X5d7vcRSX0IYyXB-F8MNUKct_tpwwZRQ56ikTbpR1lEQjWreotFin5hGqtqxvmmNnwArYHl_4ffUE1zi2dpY8EI7N_hVFjRaChCM5W7YH12IaNBDo0aSJSe3ojoDq2pnkrPuiB-Q2BueL7-nhbknH0oUpVqCWiRVjolUOPHVbVxX2nOZN200r9Qod688S-EIuixekZhk-_96V8tE1lOwuCFVfUtfit8Hfe5yT5ShxzZZtjqikuzIVV1YfcALUFdTi9i5fuxySNThc4HhtPxiyZ9fjivFgIYjomk62mGSUxKfoPj1mQyI7RJtp3I8HlOVMaEXfezz4bKCZQOIZnZ351FXy3vJ7K0m)**

_-- Senator Tommy Tuberville_

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

**Peter, we're six months away from the midterm elections — and the stakes are as high as ever. ** The Supreme Court’s decision to gut key protections of the Voting Rights Act has ignited a new fire under Republicans, who are moving fast to manipulate the maps ahead of November. That’s right — we’re six months out, and Republicans have just kicked off a new wave of attempts to redraw congressional maps to try to rig the outcome. It’s absurd and deeply cynical, but this has been their strategy from the get-go. So much is on the line this November, and it’s critical that the will of the people prevails. **What happens this fall will determine the path forward on a whole host of issues:_climate justice, reproductive rights, education, health care, affordability... You name it, it’s at stake_.** And as A.G. Eric Holder said the other day, this is about restoring checks and balances and accountability for those who aren’t playing by the rules: "A House run by Democrats will issue subpoenas, will hold hearings. We'll look at the rampant corruption of this administration. We'll put administration officials under oath and ask them questions. That's the last thing in the world that they want to have happen." But it’s not just about what happens in Congress. The fair maps movement has identified dozens of critical state-level elections where who wins could determine the direction our democracy takes for years to come. **So, if you haven't contributed this year, I ask you to help now.[There’s no better time to strengthen our firewall for democracy and support the NDRC’s essential work to protect voting rights and preserve democracy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131203401/620283789/1630712388?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_SixMonthsElection_email_20260511-NDRC-Tier1-SixMonthsElection_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260511-NDRC-Tier1-SixMonthsElection_&utm_campaign=SixMonthsElection&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5N2NiNTY4LTY3NGQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gAAcgxlY2uYQXw_uykQKqHZ4ScIcF1yTAknQVV2f_rI=)** Thank you — we can't do this without you, Claire Low

Here’s what the redistricting wars stand right now:
#
Peter,
Last week, after the Supreme Court weakened a key part of the Voting Rights Act, Republican lawmakers wasted no time.
They got right back to what they do best when they’re scared of voters: changing the lines instead of their policies.
We’re witnessing a coordinated, cross-country push to redraw congressional maps mid-decade.
[**Rush in a donation of $3 right now to help us fight back against these anti-voter schemes happening across the nation.**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260511-1-ak.jWBVAY&amount=3&refcode=em20260511-117&t=1&akid=117%2E1366028%2EZAnze9)
**Here’s what the redistricting wars stand right now, Peter:**
* In Tennessee, the legislature moved very quickly to carve up a single Democratic-leaning district and spread almost all of its voters across multiple Republican districts

* In Virginia, voters recently voted yes to redraw their maps, and then the courts threw the process into chaos by striking it down

* In Texas, Republicans pushed through a mid-decade map designed to tilt multiple seats towards Republicans

* In Florida, lawmakers are moving to redraw maps in ways that weaken districts where voters of color have been able to elect candidates of their choice

* In Alabama, Republican lawmakers are preparing a special election to redraw their maps, potentially erasing two Black majority districts

**Republicans are using every tool they have at their disposal to lock in power, shrink the number of competitive seats, and dilute the voting strength of communities of color.**
And the scariest part is what comes next.
Once one state pulls this off, others follow. It becomes a cycle — redraw, sue, redraw again, and keep pushing until communities just completely lose fair representation.
**That’s why Voto Latino is responding the way we always do.**
We’re mobilizing across the country, registering eligible voters, fighting back in the courts when we can, and making sure our communities have the tools to show up in November. **Because gerrymandering can change the rules, but it can’t stop us from organizing and turning out in big numbers.**
**[If you are ready to help us fight back nationwide, will you chip in today to support Voto Latino’s voter registration and mobilization work?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260511-1-ak.jWBVAY&amount=3&refcode=em20260511-117&t=2&akid=117%2E1366028%2EZAnze9)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

**MESSAGE FROM CHIP ROY**
Let me be direct.

Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff.

That didn't happen by accident.

It happened because the people of Texas still value truth over spin—and results over a bankroll.

My opponent poured more than $16 million of his own money into this race, only to finish at 39%. Meanwhile, we were hit by a California-based, left-wing PAC angry that I stood with Donald Trump to strip out hundreds of billions in Green New Deal-style subsidies from the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill."

**They thought they could buy Texas._They were wrong._**

The runoff election is May 26 - less than three weeks away - and with your help, we're going to finish what we started and prove, once again, that Texas isn't for sale.

clean_body: I've enclosed our latest campaign update on the status of this critical runoff election. Please Read: | MESSAGE FROM CHIP ROY Let me be direct. Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff. That didn't happen by accident. It happened because the people of Texas still value truth over spin—and results over a bankroll. My opponent poured more than $16 million of his own money into this race, only to finish at 39%. Meanwhile, we were hit by a California-based, left-wing PAC angry that I stood with Donald Trump to strip out hundreds of billions in Green New Deal-style subsidies from the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill." They thought they could buy Texas.They were wrong. The runoff election is May 26 - less than three weeks away - and with your help, we're going to finish what we started and prove, once again, that Texas isn't for sale. But let's be honest about what's at stake. This is no time to hand the Attorney General's office to someone who's never set foot in a courtroom. Texas is facing serious challenges: a wide-open border, foreign adversaries buying up our land, and a radical agenda determined to reshape our state and our country. We need a proven conservative who knows how to fight - and win. The Attorney General isn't a ceremonial role. It's the chief legal officer of the largest conservative state in America. It requires leadership from day one—building a strong legal team, enforcing the law without hesitation, and taking the fight wherever it's needed to defend Texas. I'm ready to do that. But I need to know if conservatives like you are in this fight with me. Between now and May 26th, I'll be working around the clock to make sure Texans understand exactly what's on the line in this runoff. Let's finish this. name: Team Gina
subject: We’re seeing a shift in Texas
body:
Change is already here, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
We’re starting to see a shift in Texas, Peter.
**Last week, voters across the state fought back at the ballot box and rejected the GOP’s chaos and corruption. From city halls to school boards, Texans chose leaders who will actually show up and do the work.**
Here’s what happened:
* In Pearland, **Quentin Wiltz** was elected mayor in a Republican stronghold.
* In Arlington, **Brittney Garcia-Dumas** flipped a city council seat in the 5th district.
* In Denton, **Jordan Villarreal** won a city council seat in the 1st district, and **Anita Martinez-Strickland** won a seat on the Denton ISD Board of Trustees.
* In Grapevine,**Matthew White** , **Lindsey Sheguit** , and **Darrell Brown** ousted GOP-aligned incumbents on the Grapevine-Colleyville Independent School District Board.
* In San Antonio, **Michael Adam Wulczyn** and **Caprice Garcia** flipped two seats on the North East ISD Board of Trustees.
* In Travis County, **Tiffany Bennett** and **Natalie Nugent** flipped two seats on the Lake Travis ISD Board of Trustees.

These wins didn’t just come out of nowhere. They match what we’re hearing everywhere we go.
Texans are tired of leaders who serve their donors first and families second. They’re tired of watching public school funding being gutted and costs rising. They’re tired of the corruption and the distractions.
**This is what the early days of a blue wave look like.** It starts locally, it builds momentum, and then it shows up statewide.
So if anyone tells you Texas can’t change — _they’re wrong_. **Change is already here.**

body:
My campaign for Governor of Wisconsin is the most important race I’ve ever run.
These emails are the best way for our campaign to stay in touch with supporters like you. If you'd prefer to unsubscribe, [click here](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7010?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.11_running_B1_F1_S1_C1_30DO30DC_N-T0&t=1&akid=6148%2E196590%2ESTTBbV).

| [ ](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7008?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.11_running_B1_F1_S1_C1_30DO30DC_N-T0&t=4&akid=6148%2E196590%2ESTTBbV) I’ve prepared for some big marathons, triathlons, and even the Iron Man – but my campaign for Governor of Wisconsin is the most important race I’ve ever run. 🏃🏾

[**_But I can’t cross this finish line alone, so will you chip in $10 or more to help us keep Wisconsin blue and come out on top?_**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7039?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.11_running_B1_F1_S1_C1_30DO30DC_N-T0&t=5&akid=6148%2E196590%2ESTTBbV) | | [ CHIP IN NOW → ](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7039?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.11_running_B1_F1_S1_C1_30DO30DC_N-T0&t=6&akid=6148%2E196590%2ESTTBbV)
---
There’s nothing better than hitting the road on a run before most of Wisconsin wakes up.

Running marathons has taught me that **races aren’t won in the final sprint.**

They’re won in the miles nobody sees; the high-stakes middle where you have to keep a steady pace and ignore your legs when they’re ready to give out.

**That’s exactly how I’m running this campaign.**

But right now, the polls show our campaign in a dead heat – we’re only up by 2%. The work we put in today to pull ahead is what will decide this race in November.

name: AOC
subject: My ambition is way bigger than that.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Presidents come and go.
#
Last week, on [Ilana Glazer's podcast](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/37152?t=1&akid=11391%2E2526796%2Eaebngq), I said, "You can’t earn a billion dollars. You can get market power, you can break rules, you can abuse labor laws, you can pay people less than what they’re worth, but you can’t earn that."
The next day, in an op-ed that Jeff Bezos paid for in The Washington Post, there was this line — “As a potential 2028 contender... XYZ.”
And in the context of that, it was very clear that this was a veiled threat.
It was the elite saying, "If you want this job, you just stepped out of line. We want you to know where the real power is: It's the modern-day barons that own the Post and the algorithms — and we'll make an example out of you."
What’s funny about that is they assume my ambition is _positional_. They assume that my ambition is a title, or a seat.
My ambition is way bigger than that. **My ambition is to change this country**.
Presidents come and go. Senate, House seats, elected officials come and go.
But **single-payer healthcare is forever**.
A living wage is forever.
Workers’ rights are forever.
Women’s rights are forever.
When you aren't attached — when you haven't been fantasizing about office since you were 6 or 7 years old — it is tremendously liberating. Because I get to wake up every day and say, **"How am I going to meet the moment?"**
Conditions change radically all the time. So I make my response less to an attachment to some title and position, and working backwards from there, but by waking up in the morning and observing the conditions in this country.
And I say, "What decision can I make today that is going to get us closer to that future — stronger, faster, better — than yesterday?"
Thank you for standing with me in that fight.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

name: Adem T. Bunkeddeko
subject: How 'Bout Those Knicks
body:
Buy the Knicks!

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Friends,Ever since we announced our plan to “Buy The Knicks” in The New York Times, something funny happened:The Knicks started winning.Coincidence? Probably.But one thing is clear: New Yorkers are excited by the idea that the people who create the value should share in the upside.Teams like the Knicks and Rangers become billion-dollar franchises because of the fans who fill the Garden, buy the jerseys, and make these teams part of New York’s identity. The public creates the value, but a handful of billionaires capture nearly all of it.I think New Yorkers deserve a different model.And before anyone says it’s impossible, versions of this have already worked. The Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan once owned the Raptors, Maple Leafs, and their arena, later generating more than $1.3 billion for retirees.As Comptroller, I believe the pension fund should invest in what makes New York, New York — not as a stunt, but as a serious long-term investment strategy that can deliver strong returns while giving working people a stake in the institutions they help build.[If you agree, chip in today and help us keep building this movement!](https://us.list-manage.com/lDTaaqWL81A?e=5702859c35&c2id=d81f0eeb8df9a762172d9a6d0e35641a)Let’s go Knicks.Adem

clean_body: Buy the Knicks! | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends,Ever since we announced our plan to “Buy The Knicks” in The New York Times, something funny happened:The Knicks started winning.Coincidence? Probably.But one thing is clear: New Yorkers are excited by the idea that the people who create the value should share in the upside.Teams like the Knicks and Rangers become billion-dollar franchises because of the fans who fill the Garden, buy the jerseys, and make these teams part of New York’s identity. The public creates the value, but a handful of billionaires capture nearly all of it.I think New Yorkers deserve a different model.And before anyone says it’s impossible, versions of this have already worked. The Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan once owned the Raptors, Maple Leafs, and their arena, later generating more than $1.3 billion for retirees.As Comptroller, I believe the pension fund should invest in what makes New York, New York — not as a stunt, but as a serious long-term investment strategy that can deliver strong returns while giving working people a stake in the institutions they help build.’s go Knicks.Adem | | | | | | | | | Adem for New York PO Box 130427 Brooklyn NY 11213-0427 Brooklyn, NY 112130427 USA or |

| Peter,

I’m leading the fight for immigrant communities in Congress.

When the Trump administration tried to weaponize the IRS against immigrants, I stepped up — leading a letter to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and holding the Trump administration to account.

That’s what leaders do: **step up when marginalized communities are under attack.**

Backing down isn’t an option. It isn’t an option for working-class families and immigrants who are struggling to survive in Trump’s America.

I’m fighting for them, and I won’t rest until costs come down and immigrants are protected from ICE abuses.

Happy belated Mother's Day + speaker features!

**May 11, 2026** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
First—happy belated Mother’s Day to all the incredible moms in our community. We took yesterday offline to spend time with family, and honestly, it felt fitting for today’s letter to reflect on the women who shape not just our homes—but the future of our state and country.
Rocky Mountain Voice itself is run by a mom and a daughter who care deeply about preserving Colorado for the next generation. This platform was built out of faith, conviction, late nights, risk, perseverance—and a belief that with moms, anything is possible.
**And this week, two of the speakers we announced for Freedom Festival reminded us of that in a powerful way.**
**Beverly Vance Aikins** —mother of Vice President J.D. Vance—will be joining us to share her story of addiction, recovery, redemption, and rebuilding a life through faith and perseverance. Her story is deeply personal, but it’s also one so many mothers and families across America can relate to.
We also announced **Patti Fox** , a Colorado mother whose advocacy began after her daughter was critically injured in a hit-and-run involving an illegal immigrant who fled the scene. Patti has become a powerful voice for victims’ rights, public safety, and standing up for families who feel unheard.
These are the kinds of stories—and people—that Freedom Festival is all about.
We also announced **Lee Habeeb** , creator of Our American Stories, and nationally known election analyst **Seth Keshel** as part of the growing lineup this week. And there’s much more to come. **A full website of speakers is coming this week!**
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| | We truly believe this is shaping up to be something special for Colorado—and we can’t wait to share more with you this week.
👉 **[Get your tickets now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** 👉 Join our **[priority list](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** to be the first to know when new speakers are annoucned!
In truth & liberty, Team RMV

Colorado residents have spent years watching prices climb while business groups warn that operating in the state is becoming harder. A new report adds another layer of data to those concerns.

**LEGISLATIVE SESSION**
_**Quick Summary of the Week:**_ 🏛️ _**In the Senate:**__Senate Republicans celebrated a major committee victory this week after killing _[SB26-176](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ , the so-called “No Kings Act,” arguing the bill would have opened the door to costly and duplicative lawsuits against public employees. At the same time, debate intensified over continued efforts to weaken TABOR through measures like _[SB26-135](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ and _[HB26-1419](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ , which critics say would allow the state to retain billions that would otherwise be refunded to taxpayers. The Senate also paused to recognize the University of Denver hockey team’s national championship and commemorate the National Day of Prayer at the Capitol._
🏛️ _**In the House:** As the final days of session ramped up, House lawmakers pushed through a wave of major legislation focused on public safety, behavioral health, cybersecurity, and workforce development. A key focus this week was _[SB26-149](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ , aimed at reforming Colorado’s troubled competency system after years of lawsuits, delays, and millions in taxpayer penalties tied to failures in mental health evaluations and treatment services. Lawmakers also advanced bills targeting retail theft, child exploitation crimes, and healthcare affordability, while Republicans continued raising concerns over proposals they argue weaken TABOR protections and expand government fee structures._
📅 **Coming Up This Week:**_The 2026 legislative session officially wraps up Wednesday, bringing an end to months of intense debate, late-night hearings, and hundreds of controversial bills. With only limited committee activity remaining, lawmakers are racing to finalize last-minute legislation and negotiations before adjournment. Activists and advocates are already shifting focus toward the 2026 ballot measures and upcoming elections, warning that the policy fights happening under the Gold Dome this year are far from over._

Peter, Lauren has a history of fighting for working families.

As a labor organizer, she led campaigns to defend Social Security benefits, increase workers’ pay and protections, and make sure everyone was treated fairly in the workplace.

And as the chief public affairs officer for one of the largest Planned Parenthood affiliates in the nation, she’s been at the forefront of the movement to keep our reproductive rights safe.

**Now, she’s running for Congress to fight back against Republicans’ efforts to gut our hard-earned benefits like Medicaid and SNAP. She’ll work every day to bring real relief to working families like hers.**

_**But she can’t win this race without your help, Peter!**_

If Lauren’s going to pull ahead of her opponents and win, we have to get her message out to people across the district.

Last week was a _GREAT_ week for [#LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29677753.14729.1.dba67c767124bba4f7ae7447f56e88c5) when **President Donald Trump** endorsed me for Congress! Today, I am excited to share another GREAT endorsement... which is BIG! I am grateful for the support of one of the most influential organizations in Conservative politics, **The Club For Growth**. They've spent decades fighting for lower taxes, less regulation, and economic freedom. Having their backing means this campaign is serious about delivering results for Oklahoma families and businesses. “ _As a pastor, Jackson Lahmeyer stood up to big-government bureaucrats by refusing to enforce mandates, and he’s going to do the same thing in the Washington Swamp as a Member of Congress. Lahmeyer is a conservative champion that will support limited government and economic freedom, and we are proud to join President Trump in endorsing him_.” - **Club for Growth PAC President David McIntosh** I am running for Congress in Oklahoma's 1st District to do several things: **-Keep Our Borders Secure** **-Remove Illegal Criminals From Our Streets** **-Help Make Living In America Affordable For Americans** **-Not Allowing The Chinese Communist Party To Own American Farmland** **-Ensuring That Sharia Law Never Takes Root In Our Nation** Also, join me tonight at **Northeastern State University** in Broken Arrow for the **OK-1 Candidate Forum**! I'll be there to talk about the issues that matter to Oklahoma families. Come out, ask tough questions, and see for yourself who's ready to fight for this district and _which candidates don't show up..._ Doors open at 5:30. See you there!

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. clean_body: A once-in-a-lifetime Memorial Day for America and our veterans | | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Tim Holbert President American Veterans Center | | | The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today.
